εα.def: apparent imperative of ἐάω (G1439); properly, let it be, i.e. (as interjection) aha!. KJV: let alone.

εαν.def: from εἰ (G1487) and ἄν (G302); a conditional particle; in case that, provided, etc.; often used in connection with other particles to denote indefiniteness or uncertainty. KJV: before, but, except, (and) if, (if) so, (what-, whither-)soever, though, when (-soever), whether (or), to whom, (who-)so(-ever).

εανμη.def: i.e. ἐάν (G1437) and μή (G3361); if not, i.e. unless. KJV: X before, but, except, if, no, (if, + whosoever) not.

εαυτου.def: from a reflexive pronoun otherwise obsolete and the genitive case (dative case or accusative case) of αὐτός (G846); him- (her-, it-, them-, also (in conjunction with the personal pronoun of the other persons) my-, thy-, our-, your-) self (selves), etc. KJV: alone, her (own, -self), (he) himself, his (own), itself, one (to) another, our (thine) own(-selves), + that she had, their (own, own selves), (of) them(-selves), they, thyself, you, your (own, own conceits, own selves, -selves).

εαω.def: of uncertain affinity; to let be, i.e. permit or leave alone. KJV: commit, leave, let (alone), suffer.

εβδομηκοντα.def: from ἕβδομος (G1442) and a modified form of δέκα (G1176); seventy. KJV: seventy, three score and ten.

εβδομηκοντακισ.def: multiple adverb from ἑβδομήκοντα (G1440); seventy times. KJV: seventy times.

εβδομοσ.def: ordinal from ἑπτά (G2033); seventh. KJV: seventh.

εβερ.def: of Hebrew origin (H5677); Eber, a patriarch. KJV: Eber.

εβραικοσ.def: from Ἐβέρ (G1443); Hebraic or the Jewish language. KJV: Hebrew.

εβραιοσ.def: from Ἐβέρ (G1443); a Hebræan (i.e. Hebrew) or Jew. KJV: Hebrew.

εβραισ.def: from Ἐβέρ (G1443); the Hebraistic (Hebrew) or Jewish (Chaldee) language. KJV: Hebrew.

εβραιστι.def: adverb from Ἑβραΐς (G1446); Hebraistically or in the Jewish (Chaldee) language. KJV: in (the) Hebrew (tongue).

εγγιζω.def: from ἐγγύς (G1451); to make near, i.e. (reflexively) approach. KJV: approach, be at hand, come (draw) near, be (come, draw) nigh.

εγγραφω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and γράφω (G1125); to "engrave", i.e. inscribe. KJV: write (in).

εγγυοσ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and γυῖον (a limb); pledged (as if articulated by a member), i.e. a bondsman. KJV: surety.

εγγυσ.def: from a primary verb ἄγχω (to squeeze or throttle; akin to the base of ἀγκάλη (G43)); near (literally or figuratively, of place or time). KJV: from, at hand, near, nigh (at hand, unto), ready.

εγγυτερον.def: neuter of the comparative of ἐγγύς (G1451); nearer. KJV: nearer.

εγειρω.def: probably akin to the base of ἀγορά (G58) (through the idea of collecting one's faculties); to waken (transitively or intransitively), i.e. rouse (literally, from sleep, from sitting or lying, from disease, from death; or figuratively, from obscurity, inactivity, ruins, nonexistence). KJV: awake, lift (up), raise (again, up), rear up, (a-)rise (again, up), stand, take up.

εγερσισ.def: from ἐγείρω (G1453); a resurgence (from death). KJV: resurrection.

εγκαθετοσ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and a derivative of καθίημι (G2524); subinduced, i.e. surreptitiously suborned as a lier-in-wait. KJV: spy.

εγκαινια.def: neuter plural of a presumed compound from ἐν (G1722) and καινός (G2537); innovatives, i.e. (specially) renewal (of religious services after the Antiochian interruption). KJV: dedication.

εγκαινιζω.def: from ἐγκαίνια (G1456); to renew, i.e. inaugurate. KJV: consecrate, dedicate.

εγκαλεω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and καλέω (G2564); to call in (as a debt or demand), i.e. bring to account (charge, criminate, etc.). KJV: accuse, call in question, implead, lay to the charge.

εγκαταλειπω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and καταλείπω (G2641); to leave behind in some place, i.e. (in a good sense) let remain over, or (in a bad sense) to desert. KJV: forsake, leave.

εγκατοικεω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and κατοικέω (G2730); to settle down in a place, i.e. reside. KJV: dwell among.

εγκεντριζω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and a derivative of κέντρον (G2759); to prick in, i.e. ingraft. KJV: graff in(-to).

εγκλημα.def: from ἐγκαλέω (G1458); an accusation, i.e. offence alleged. KJV: crime laid against, laid to charge.

εγκομβοομαι.def: middle voice from ἐν (G1722) and κομβόω (to gird); to engirdle oneself (for labor), i.e. figuratively (the apron as being a badge of servitude) to wear (in token of mutual deference). KJV: be clothed with.

εγκοπη.def: from ἐγκόπτω (G1465); a hindrance. KJV: X hinder.

εγκοπτω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and κόπτω (G2875); to cut into, i.e. (figuratively) impede, detain. KJV: hinder, be tedious unto.

εγκρατεια.def: from ἐγκρατής (G1468); self-control (especially continence). KJV: temperance.

εγκρατευομαι.def: middle voice from ἐγκρατής (G1468); to exercise self-restraint (in diet and chastity). KJV: can(-not) contain, be temperate.

εγκρατησ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and κράτος (G2904); strong in a thing (masterful), i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) self-controlled (in appetite, etc.). KJV: temperate.

εγκρινω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and κρίνω (G2919); to judge in, i.e. count among. KJV: make of the number.

εγκρυπτω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and κρύπτω (G2928); to conceal in, i.e. incorporate with. KJV: hid in.

εγκυοσ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and the base of κῦμα (G2949); swelling inside, i.e. pregnant. KJV: great with child.

εγχριω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and χρίω (G5548); to rub in (oil), i.e. besmear. KJV: anoint.

εγω.def: a primary pronoun of the first person I (only expressed when emphatic). KJV: I, me.

εδαφιζω.def: from ἔδαφος (G1475); to raze. KJV: lay even with the ground.

εδαφοσ.def: from the base of ἑδραῖος (G1476); a basis (bottom), i.e. the soil. KJV: ground.

εδραιοσ.def: from a derivative of ἕζομαι (to sit); sedentary, i.e. (by implication) immovable. KJV: settled, stedfast.

εδραιωμα.def: from a derivative of ἑδραῖος (G1476); a support, i.e. (figuratively) basis. KJV: ground.

εζεκιασ.def: of Hebrew origin (H2396); Ezekias (i.e. Hezekeiah), an Israelite. KJV: Ezekias.

εθελοθρησκεια.def: from θέλω (G2309) and θρησκεία (G2356); voluntary (arbitrary and unwarranted) piety, i.e. sanctimony. KJV: will worship.

εθιζω.def: from ἔθος (G1485); to accustom, i.e. (neuter passive participle) customary. KJV: custom.

εθναρχησ.def: from ἔθνος (G1484) and ἀρχή (G746); the governor (not king) of a district. KJV: ethnarch.

εθνικοσ.def: from ἔθνος (G1484); national ("ethnic"), i.e. (specially) a Gentile. KJV: heathen (man).

εθνικωσ.def: adverb from ἐθνικός (G1482); as a Gentile. KJV: after the manner of Gentiles.

εθνοσ.def: probably from ἔθω (G1486); a race (as of the same habit), i.e. a tribe; specially, a foreign (non-Jewish) one (usually, by implication, pagan). KJV: Gentile, heathen, nation, people.

εθοσ.def: from ἔθω (G1486); a usage (prescribed by habit or law). KJV: custom, manner, be wont.

εθω.def: a primary verb; to be used (by habit or conventionality); neuter perfect participle usage. KJV: be custom (manner, wont).

ει.def: a primary particle of conditionality; if, whether, that, etc. KJV: forasmuch as, if, that, (al-)though, whether.
second person singular present of εἰμί (G1510); thou art. KJV: art, be.

ειγε.def: from εἰ (G1487) and γέ (G1065); if indeed, seeing that, unless, (with negative) otherwise. KJV: if (so be that, yet).

ειδεμηγε.def: from εἰ (G1487), δέ (G1161), and μή (G3361) (sometimes with γέ (G1065) added); but if not. KJV: (or) else, if (not, otherwise), otherwise.

ειδοσ.def: from εἴδω (G1492); a view, i.e. form (literally or figuratively). KJV: appearance, fashion, shape, sight.

ειδω.def: a primary verb; used only in certain past tenses, the others being borrowed from the equivalent ὀπτάνομαι (G3700) and ὁράω (G3708); properly, to see (literally or figuratively); by implication, (in the perfect tense only) to know. KJV: be aware, behold, X can (+ not tell), consider, (have) know(-ledge), look (on), perceive, see, be sure, tell, understand, wish, wot.

ειδωλειον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of εἴδωλον (G1497); an image-fane. KJV: idol's temple.

ειδωλοθυτον.def: neuter of a compound of εἴδωλον (G1497) and a presumed derivative of θύω (G2380); an image-sacrifice, i.e. part of an idolatrous offering. KJV: (meat, thing that is) offered (in sacrifice, sacrificed) to (unto) idols.

ειδωλολατρεια.def: from εἴδωλον (G1497) and λατρεία (G2999); image-worship (literally or figuratively). KJV: idolatry.

ειδωλολατρησ.def: from εἴδωλον (G1497) and the base of λατρεύω (G3000); an image- (servant or) worshipper (literally or figuratively). KJV: idolater.

ειδωλον.def: from εἶδος (G1491); an image (i.e. for worship); by implication, a heathen god, or (plural) the worship of such. KJV: idol.

ειην.def: optative (i.e. English subjunctive) present of εἰμί (G1510) (including the other person); might (could, would, or should) be. KJV: mean, + perish, should be, was, were.

εικαι.def: from εἰ (G1487) and καί (G2532); if also (or even). KJV: if (that), though.

εικη.def: probably from εἴκω (G1502) (through the idea of failure); idly, i.e. without reason (or effect). KJV: without a cause, (in) vain(-ly).

εικοσι.def: of uncertain affinity; a score. KJV: twenty.

εικω.def: apparently a primary verb; properly, to be weak, i.e. yield. KJV: give place.
apparently a primary verb (perhaps akin to εἴκω (G1502) through the idea of faintness as a copy); to resemble. KJV: be like.

εικων.def: from εἴκω (G1503); a likeness, i.e. (literally) statue, profile, or (figuratively) representation, resemblance. KJV: image.

ειλικρινεια.def: from εἰλικρινής (G1506); clearness, i.e. (by implication) purity (figuratively). KJV: sincerity.

ειλικρινησ.def: from εἵλη (the sun's ray) and κρίνω (G2919); judged by sunlight, i.e. tested as genuine (figuratively). KJV: pure, sincere.

ειλισσω.def: a prolonged form of a primary but defective verb εἵλω (of the same meaning); to coil or wrap. KJV: roll together.

ειμη.def: from εἰ (G1487) and μή (G3361); if not. KJV: but, except (that), if not, more than, save (only) that, saving, till.

ειμητι.def: from εἰ μή (G1508) and the neuter of τὶς (G5100); if not somewhat. KJV: except.

ειμι.def: the first person singular present indicative; a prolonged form of a primary and defective verb; I exist (used only when emphatic). KJV: am, have been, X it is I, was.

ειναι.def: present infinitive from εἰμί (G1510); to exist. KJV: am, was.

ειπερ.def: from εἰ (G1487) and περ (G4007); if perhaps. KJV: if so be (that), seeing, though.

ειπωσ.def: from εἰ (G1487) and -πώς (G4458); if somehow. KJV: if by any means.

ειρηνευω.def: from εἰρήνη (G1515); to be (act) peaceful. KJV: be at (have, live in) peace, live peaceably.

ειρηνη.def: probably from a primary verb εἴρω (to join); peace (literally or figuratively); by implication, prosperity. KJV: one, peace, quietness, rest, + set at one again.

ειρηνικοσ.def: from εἰρήνη (G1515); pacific; by implication, salutary. KJV: peaceable.

ειρηνοποιεω.def: from εἰρηνοποιός (G1518); to be a peace-maker, i.e. (figuratively) to harmonize. KJV: make peace.

ειρηνοποιοσ.def: from εἰρήνη (G1515) and ποιέω (G4160); pacificatory, i.e. (subjectively) peaceable. KJV: peacemaker.

εισ.def: a primary preposition; to or into (indicating the point reached or entered), of place, time, or (figuratively) purpose (result, etc.); also in adverbial phrases. KJV: (abundant-)ly, against, among, as, at, (back-)ward, before, by, concerning, + continual, + far more exceeding, for (intent, purpose), fore, + forth, in (among, at, unto, -so much that, -to), to the intent that, + of one mind, + never, of, (up-)on, + perish, + set at one again, (so) that, therefore(-unto), throughout, til, to (be, the end, -ward), (here-)until(-to), …ward, (where-)fore, with.
a primary numeral; one. KJV: a(-n, -ny, certain), + abundantly, man, one (another), only, other, some.

εισαγω.def: from εἰς (G1519) and ἄγω (G71); to introduce (literally or figuratively). KJV: bring in(-to), (+ was to) lead into.

εισακουω.def: from εἰς (G1519) and ἀκούω (G191); to listen to. KJV: hear.

εισδεχομαι.def: from εἰς (G1519) and δέχομαι (G1209); to take into one's favor. KJV: receive.

εισειμι.def: from εἰς (G1519) and εἶμι (to go); to enter. KJV: enter (go) into.

εισερχομαι.def: from εἰς (G1519) and ἔρχομαι (G2064); to enter (literally or figuratively). KJV: X arise, come (in, into), enter in(-to), go in (through).

εισι.def: 3rd person plural present indicative of εἰμί (G1510); they are. KJV: agree, are, be, dure, X is, were.

εισκαθεισ.def: from εἷς (G1520) repeated with κατά (G2596) inserted; severally. KJV: one by one.

εισκαλεω.def: from εἰς (G1519) and καλέω (G2564); to invite in. KJV: call in.

εισοδοσ.def: from εἰς (G1519) and ὁδός (G3598); an entrance (literally or figuratively). KJV: coming, enter(-ing) in (to).

εισπηδαω.def: from εἰς (G1519) and πηδάω (to leap); to rush in. KJV: run (spring) in.

εισπορευομαι.def: from εἰς (G1519) and πορεύομαι (G4198); to enter (literally or figuratively). KJV: come (enter) in, go into.

ειστρεχω.def: from εἰς (G1519) and τρέχω (G5143); to hasten inward. KJV: run in.

εισφερω.def: from εἰς (G1519) and φέρω (G5342); to carry inward (literally or figuratively). KJV: bring (in), lead into.

ειτα.def: of uncertain affinity; a particle of succession (in time or logical enumeration), then, moreover. KJV: after that(-ward), furthermore, then.

ειτε.def: from εἰ (G1487) and τέ (G5037); if too. KJV: if, or, whether.

ειτισ.def: from εἰ (G1487) and τὶς (G5100); if any. KJV: he that, if a(-ny) man('s thing, from any, ought), whether any, whosoever.

εκ.def: a primary preposition denoting origin (the point whence action or motion proceeds), from, out (of place, time, or cause; literal or figurative; direct or remote). KJV: after, among, X are, at, betwixt(-yond), by (the means of), exceedingly, (+ abundantly above), for(- th), from (among, forth, up), + grudgingly, + heartily, X heavenly, X hereby, + very highly, in, …ly, (because, by reason) of, off (from), on, out among (from, of), over, since, X thenceforth, through, X unto, X vehemently, with(-out).

εκαστοσ.def: as if a superlative of ἕκας (afar); each or every. KJV: any, both, each (one), every (man, one, woman), particularly.

εκαστοτε.def: as if from ἕκαστος (G1538) and τότε (G5119); at every time. KJV: always.

εκατον.def: of uncertain affinity; a hundred. KJV: hundred.

εκατονταετησ.def: from ἑκατόν (G1540) and ἔτος (G2094); centenarian. KJV: hundred years old.

εκατονταπλασιων.def: from ἑκατόν (G1540) and a presumed derivative of πλάσσω (G4111); a hundred times. KJV: hundredfold.

εκατονταρχησ.def: from ἑκατόν (G1540) and ἄρχω (G757); the captain of one hundred men. KJV: centurion.

εκβαλλω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and βάλλω (G906); to eject (literally or figuratively). KJV: bring forth, cast (forth, out), drive (out), expel, leave, pluck (pull, take, thrust) out, put forth (out), send away (forth, out).

εκβασισ.def: from a compound of ἐκ (G1537) and the base of βάσις (G939) (meaning to go out); an exit (literally or figuratively). KJV: end, way to escape.

εκβολη.def: from ἐκβάλλω (G1544); ejection, i.e. (specially) a throwing overboard of the cargo. KJV: + lighten the ship.

εκγαμιζω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and a form of γαμίσκω (G1061) (compare ἐκγαμίσκω (G1548)); to marry off a daughter. KJV: give in marriage.

εκγαμισκω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and γαμίσκω (G1061); the same as 1547. KJV: give in marriage.

εκγονον.def: neuter of a derivative of a compound of ἐκ (G1537) and γίνομαι (G1096); a descendant, i.e. (specially) grandchild. KJV: nephew.

εκδαπαναω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and δαπανάω (G1159); to expend (wholly), i.e. (figuratively) exhaust. KJV: spend.

εκδεχομαι.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and δέχομαι (G1209); to accept from some source, i.e. (by implication) to await. KJV: expect, look (tarry) for, wait (for).

εκδηλοσ.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and δῆλος (G1212); wholly evident. KJV: manifest.

εκδημεω.def: from a compound of ἐκ (G1537) and δῆμος (G1218); to emigrate, i.e. (figuratively) vacate or quit. KJV: be absent.

εκδιδωμι.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and δίδωμι (G1325); to give forth, i.e. (specially) to lease. KJV: let forth (out).

εκδιηγεομαι.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and a compound of διά (G1223) and ἡγέομαι (G2233); to narrate through wholly. KJV: declare.

εκδικεω.def: from ἔκδικος (G1558); to vindicate, retaliate, punish. KJV: a (re-)venge.

εκδικησισ.def: from ἐκδικέω (G1556); vindication, retribution. KJV: (a-, re-)venge(-ance), punishment.

εκδικοσ.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and δίκη (G1349); carrying justice out, i.e. a punisher. KJV: a (re-)venger.

εκδιωκω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and διώκω (G1377); to pursue out, i.e. expel or persecute implacably. KJV: persecute.

εκδοτοσ.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and a derivative of δίδωμι (G1325); given out or over, i.e. surrendered. KJV: delivered.

εκδοχη.def: from ἐκδέχομαι (G1551); expectation. KJV: looking for.

εκδυω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and the base of δύνω (G1416); to cause to sink out of, i.e. (specially as of clothing) to divest. KJV: strip, take off from, unclothe.

εκει.def: of uncertain affinity; there; by extension, thither. KJV: there, thither(-ward), (to) yonder (place).

εκειθεν.def: from ἐκεῖ (G1563); thence. KJV: from that place, (from) thence, there.

εκεινοσ.def: from ἐκεῖ (G1563); that one (or (neuter) thing); often intensified by the article prefixed. KJV: he, it, the other (same), selfsame, that (same, very), X their, X them, they, this, those.

εκζητεω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ζητέω (G2212); to search out, i.e. (figuratively)investigate, crave, demand, (by Hebraism) worship. KJV: en- (re-)quire, seek after (carefully, diligently).

εκθαμβεω.def: from ἔκθαμβος (G1569); to astonish utterly. KJV: affright, greatly (sore) amaze.

εκθαμβοσ.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and θάμβος (G2285); utterly astounded. KJV: greatly wondering.

εκθετοσ.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and a derivative of τίθημι (G5087); put out, i.e. exposed to perish. KJV: cast out.

εκκαθαιρω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and καθαίρω (G2508); to cleanse thoroughly. KJV: purge (out).

εκκαιω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and καίω (G2545); to inflame deeply. KJV: burn.

εκκακεω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and κακός (G2556); to be (bad or) weak, i.e. (by implication) to fail (in heart). KJV: faint, be weary.

εκκεντεω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and the base of κέντρον (G2759); to transfix. KJV: pierce.

εκκλαω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and κλάω (G2806); to exscind. KJV: break off.

εκκλειω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and κλείω (G2808); to shut out (literally or figuratively). KJV: exclude.

εκκλησια.def: from a compound of ἐκ (G1537) and a derivative of καλέω (G2564); a calling out, i.e. (concretely) a popular meeting, especially a religious congregation (Jewish synagogue, or Christian community of members on earth or saints in heaven or both). KJV: assembly, church.

εκκλινω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and κλίνω (G2827); to deviate, i.e. (absolutely) to shun (literally or figuratively), or (relatively) to decline (from piety). KJV: avoid, eschew, go out of the way.

εκκολυμβαω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and κολυμβάω (G2860); to escape by swimming. KJV: swim out.

εκκομιζω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and κομίζω (G2865); to bear forth (to burial). KJV: carry out.

εκκοπτω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and κόπτω (G2875); to exscind; figuratively, to frustrate. KJV: cut down (off, out), hew down, hinder.

εκκρεμαμαι.def: middle voice from ἐκ (G1537) and κρεμάννυμι (G2910); to hang upon the lips of a speaker, i.e. listen closely. KJV: be very attentive.

εκλαλεω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and λαλέω (G2980); to divulge. KJV: tell.

εκλαμπω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and λάμπω (G2989); to be resplendent. KJV: shine forth.

εκλανθανομαι.def: middle voice from ἐκ (G1537) and λανθάνω (G2990); to be utterly oblivious of. KJV: forget.

εκλεγομαι.def: middle voice from ἐκ (G1537) and λέγω (G3004) (in its primary sense); to select. KJV: make choice, choose (out), chosen.

εκλειπω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and λείπω (G3007); to omit, i.e. (by implication) cease (die). KJV: fail.

εκλεκτοσ.def: from ἐκλέγομαι (G1586); select; by implication, favorite. KJV: chosen, elect.

εκλογη.def: from ἐκλέγομαι (G1586); (divine) selection (abstractly or concretely). KJV: chosen, election.

εκλυω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and λύω (G3089); to relax (literally or figuratively). KJV: faint.

εκμασσω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and the base of μασσάομαι (G3145); to knead out, i.e. (by analogy) to wipe dry. KJV: wipe.

εκμυκτηριζω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and μυκτηρίζω (G3456); to sneer outright at. KJV: deride.

εκνευω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and νεύω (G3506); (by analogy) to slip off, i.e. quietly withdraw. KJV: convey self away.

εκνηφω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and νήφω (G3525); (figuratively) to rouse (oneself) out of stupor. KJV: awake.

εκουσιον.def: neuter of a derivative from ἑκών (G1635); voluntariness. KJV: willingly.

εκουσιωσ.def: adverb from the same as ἑκούσιον (G1595); voluntarily. KJV: wilfully, willingly.

εκπαλαι.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and πάλαι (G3819); long ago, for a long while. KJV: of a long time, of old.

εκπειραζω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and πειράζω (G3985); to test thoroughly. KJV: tempt.

εκπεμπω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and πέμπω (G3992); to despatch. KJV: send away (forth).

εκπεταννυμι.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and a form of πέτομαι (G4072); to fly out, i.e. (by analogy) to extend. KJV: stretch forth.

εκπιπτω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and πίπτω (G4098); to drop away; specially, be driven out of one's course; figuratively, to lose, become inefficient. KJV: be cast, fail, fall (away, off), take none effect.

εκπλεω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and πλέω (G4126); to depart by ship. KJV: sail (away, thence).

εκπληροω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and πληρόω (G4137); to accomplish entirely. KJV: fulfill.

εκπλησσω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and πλήσσω (G4141); to strike with astonishment. KJV: amaze, astonish.

εκπνεω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and πνέω (G4154); to expire. KJV: give up the ghost.

εκπορευομαι.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and πορεύομαι (G4198); to depart, be discharged, proceed, project. KJV: come (forth, out of), depart, go (forth, out), issue, proceed (out of).

εκπορνευω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and πορνεύω (G4203); to be utterly unchaste. KJV: give self over to fornication.

εκπτυω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and πτύω (G4429); to spit out, i.e. (figuratively) spurn. KJV: reject.

εκριζοω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ῥιζόω (G4492); to uproot. KJV: pluck up by the root, root up.

εκστασισ.def: from ἐξίστημι (G1839); a displacement of the mind, i.e. bewilderment, "ecstasy". KJV: + be amazed, amazement, astonishment, trance.

εκστρεφω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and στρέφω (G4762); to pervert (figuratively). KJV: subvert.

εκταρασσω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ταράσσω (G5015); to disturb wholly. KJV: exceedingly trouble.

εκτεινω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and teino (to stretch); to extend. KJV: cast, put forth, stretch forth (out).

εκτελεω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and τελέω (G5055); to complete fully. KJV: finish.

εκτενεια.def: from ἐκτενής (G1618); intentness. KJV: X instantly.

εκτενεστερον.def: neuter of the comparative of ἐκτενής (G1618); more intently. KJV: more earnestly.

εκτενησ.def: from ἐκτείνω (G1614); intent. KJV: without ceasing, fervent.

εκτενωσ.def: adverb from ἐκτενής (G1618); intently. KJV: fervently.

εκτιθημι.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and τίθημι (G5087); to expose; figuratively, to declare. KJV: cast out, expound.

εκτινασσω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and tinasso (to swing); to shake violently. KJV: shake (off).

εκτοσ.def: from ἐκ (G1537); the exterior; figuratively (as a preposition) aside from, besides. KJV: but, except(-ed), other than, out of, outside, unless, without.
ordinal from ἕξ (G1803); sixth. KJV: sixth.

εκτρεπω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and the base of τροπή (G5157); to deflect, i.e. turn away (literally or figuratively). KJV: avoid, turn (aside, out of the way).

εκτρεφω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and τρέφω (G5142); to rear up to maturity, i.e. (genitive case) to cherish or train. KJV: bring up, nourish.

εκτρωμα.def: from a comparative of ἐκ (G1537) and τιτρώσκω (to wound); a miscarriage (abortion), i.e. (by analogy) untimely birth. KJV: born out of due time.

εκφερω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and φέρω (G5342); to bear out (literally or figuratively). KJV: bear, bring forth, carry forth (out).

εκφευγω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and φεύγω (G5343); to flee out. KJV: escape, flee.

εκφοβεω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and φοβέω (G5399); to frighten utterly. KJV: terrify.

εκφοβοσ.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and φόβος (G5401); frightened out of one's wits. KJV: sore afraid, exceedingly fear.

εκφυω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and φύω (G5453); to sprout up. KJV: put forth.

εκχεω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and χέω (to pour); to pour forth; figuratively, to bestow. KJV: gush (pour) out, run greedily (out), shed (abroad, forth), spill.

εκχωρεω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and χωρέω (G5562); to depart. KJV: depart out.

εκψυχω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ψύχω (G5594); to expire. KJV: give (yield) up the ghost.

εκων.def: of uncertain affinity; voluntary. KJV: willingly.

ελαια.def: feminine of a presumed derivative from an obsolete primary; an olive (the tree or the fruit). KJV: olive (berry, tree).

ελαιον.def: neuter of the same as ἐλαία (G1636); olive oil. KJV: oil.

ελαιων.def: from ἐλαία (G1636); an olive-orchard, i.e. (specially) the Mount of Olives. KJV: Olivet.

ελαμιτησ.def: of Hebrew origin (H5867); an Elamite or Persian. KJV: Elamite.

ελασσων.def: comparative of the same as ἐλάχιστος (G1646); smaller (in size, quantity, age or quality). KJV: less, under, worse, younger.

ελαττονεω.def: from ἐλάσσων (G1640); to diminish, i.e. fall short. KJV: have lack.

ελαττοω.def: from ἐλάσσων (G1640); to lessen (in rank or influence). KJV: decrease, make lower.

ελαυνω.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb (obsolete except in certain tenses as an alternative of this) of uncertain affinity; to push (as wind, oars or dæmonical power). KJV: carry, drive, row.

ελαφρια.def: from ἐλαφρός (G1645); levity (figuratively), i.e. fickleness. KJV: lightness.

ελαφροσ.def: probably akin to ἐλαύνω (G1643) and the base of ἐλάσσων (G1640); light, i.e. easy. KJV: light.

ελαχιστοσ.def: superlative of ἔλαχυς (short); used as equivalent to μικρός (G3398); least (in size, amount, dignity, etc.). KJV: least, very little (small), smallest.

ελαχιστοτεροσ.def: comparative of ἐλάχιστος (G1646); far less. KJV: less than the least.

ελεαζαρ.def: of Hebrew origin (H499); Eleazar, an Israelite. KJV: Eleazar.

ελεγξισ.def: from ἐλέγχω (G1651); refutation, i.e. reproof. KJV: rebuke.

ελεγχοσ.def: from ἐλέγχω (G1651); proof, conviction. KJV: evidence, reproof.

ελεγχω.def: of uncertain affinity; to confute, admonish. KJV: convict, convince, tell a fault, rebuke, reprove.

ελεεω.def: from ἔλεος (G1656); to compassionate (by word or deed, specially, by divine grace). KJV: have compassion (pity on), have (obtain, receive, shew) mercy (on).

ελεημοσυνη.def: from ἔλεος (G1656); compassionateness, i.e. (as exercised towards the poor) beneficence, or (concretely) a benefaction. KJV: alms(-deeds).

ελεοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; compassion (human or divine, especially active). KJV: (+ tender) mercy.

ελευθερια.def: from ἐλεύθερος (G1658); freedom (legitimate or licentious, chiefly moral or ceremonial). KJV: liberty.

ελευθεροσ.def: probably from the alternate of ἔρχομαι (G2064); unrestrained (to go at pleasure), i.e. (as a citizen) not a slave (whether freeborn or manumitted), or (genitive case) exempt (from obligation or liability). KJV: free (man, woman), at liberty.

ελευθεροω.def: from ἐλεύθερος (G1658); to liberate, i.e. (figuratively) to exempt (from moral, ceremonial or mortal liability). KJV: deliver, make free.

ελευσισ.def: from the alternate of ἔρχομαι (G2064); an advent. KJV: coming.

ελεφαντινοσ.def: from ἔλεφας (an "elephant"); elephantine, i.e. (by implication) composed of ivory. KJV: of ivory.

ελιακειμ.def: of Hebrew origin (H471); Eliakim, an Israelite. KJV: Eliakim.

ελιεζερ.def: of Hebrew origin (H461); Eliezer, an Israelite. KJV: Eliezer.

ελιουδ.def: of Hebrew origin (H410 and H1935); God of majesty; Eliud, an Israelite. KJV: Eliud.

ελισαβετ.def: of Hebrew origin (H472); Elisabet, an Israelitess. KJV: Elisabeth.

ελισσαιοσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H477); Elissæus, an Israelite. KJV: Elissæus.

ελισσω.def: a form of εἱλίσσω (G1507); to coil or wrap. KJV: fold up.

ελκοσ.def: probably from ἑλκύω (G1670); an ulcer (as if drawn together). KJV: sore.

ελκοω.def: from ἕλκος (G1668); to cause to ulcerate, i.e. (passively) be ulcerous. KJV: full of sores.

ελκυω.def: probably akin to αἱρέομαι (G138); to drag (literally or figuratively). KJV: draw.

ελλασ.def: of uncertain affinity; Hellas (or Greece), a country of Europe. KJV: Greece.

ελλην.def: from Ἑλλάς (G1671); a Hellen (Grecian) or inhabitant of Hellas; by extension a Greek-speaking person, especially a non-Jew. KJV: Gentile, Greek.

ελληνικοσ.def: from Ἕλλην (G1672); Hellenic, i.e. Grecian (in language). KJV: Greek.

ελληνισ.def: feminine of Ἕλλην (G1672); a Grecian (i.e. non-Jewish) woman. KJV: Greek.

ελληνιστησ.def: from a derivative of Ἕλλην (G1672); a Hellenist or Greek-speaking Jew. KJV: Grecian.

ελληνιστι.def: adverb from the same as Ἑλληνιστής (G1675); Hellenistically, i.e. in the Grecian language. KJV: Greek.

ελλογεω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and λόγος (G3056) (in the sense of account); to reckon in, i.e. attribute. KJV: impute, put on account.

ελμωδαμ.def: of Hebrew origin (perhaps for H486); Elmodam, an Israelite. KJV: Elmodam.

ελοι.def: of Chaldean origin (H426 with pronominal suffix) my God. KJV: Eloi.

ελπιζω.def: from ἐλπίς (G1680); to expect or confide. KJV: (have, thing) hope(-d) (for), trust.

ελπισ.def: from a primary ἔλπω (to anticipate, usually with pleasure); expectation (abstractly or concretely) or confidence. KJV: faith, hope.

ελυμασ.def: of foreign origin; Elymas, a wizard. KJV: Elymas.

εμαυτου.def: genitive case compound of ἐμοῦ (G1700) and αὐτός (G846); of myself so likewise the dative case ἐμαυτῷ, and accusative case ἐμαυτόν. KJV: me, mine own (self), myself.

εμβαινω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and the base of βάσις (G939); to walk on, i.e. embark (aboard a vessel), reach (a pool). KJV: come (get) into, enter (into), go (up) into, step in, take ship.

εμβαλλω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and βάλλω (G906); to throw on, i.e. (figuratively) subject to (eternal punishment). KJV: cast into.

εμβαπτω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and βάπτω (G911); to whelm on, i.e. wet (a part of the person, etc.) by contact with a fluid. KJV: dip.

εμβατευω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and a presumed derivative of the base of βάσις (G939); equivalent to ἐμβαίνω (G1684); to intrude on (figuratively). KJV: intrude into.

εμβιβαζω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and βιβάζω (to mount; causative of ἐμβαίνω (G1684)); to place on, i.e. transfer (aboard a vessel). KJV: put in.

εμβλεπω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and βλέπω (G991); to look on, i.e. (relatively) to observe fixedly, or (absolutely) to discern clearly. KJV: behold, gaze up, look upon, (could) see.

εμβριμαομαι.def: from ἐν (G1722) and βριμάομαι (to snort with anger); to have indignation on, i.e. (transitively) to blame, (intransitively) to sigh with chagrin, (specially) to sternly enjoin. KJV: straitly charge, groan, murmur against.

εμε.def: a prolonged form of μέ (G3165); me. KJV: I, me, my(-self).

εμεω.def: of uncertain affinity; to vomit. KJV: (will) spue.

εμμαινομαι.def: from ἐν (G1722) and μαίνομαι (G3105); to rave on, i.e. rage at. KJV: be mad against.

εμμανουηλ.def: of Hebrew origin (H6005); God with us; Emmanuel, a name of Christ. KJV: Emmanuel.

εμμαουσ.def: probably of Hebrew origin (compare H3222); Emmaus, a place in Palestine. KJV: Emmaus.

εμμενω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and μένω (G3306); to stay in the same place, i.e. (figuratively) persevere. KJV: continue.

εμμορ.def: of Hebrew origin (H2544); Emmor (i.e. Chamor), a Canaanite. KJV: Emmor.

εμοι.def: a prolonged form of μοί (G3427); to me. KJV: I, me, mine, my.

εμοσ.def: from the oblique cases of ἐγώ (G1473) (ἐμοί (G1698), ἐμοῦ (G1700), ἐμέ (G1691)); my. KJV: of me, mine (own), my.

εμου.def: a prolonged form of μόχθος (G3449); of me. KJV: me, mine, my.

εμπαιζω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and παίζω (G3815); to jeer at, i.e. deride. KJV: mock.

εμπαικτησ.def: from ἐμπαίζω (G1702); a derider, i.e. (by implication) a false teacher. KJV: mocker, scoffer.

εμπεριπατεω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and περιπατέω (G4043); to perambulate on a place, i.e. (figuratively) to be occupied among persons. KJV: walk in.

εμπιπλημι.def: from ἐν (G1722) and the base of πλεῖστος (G4118); to fill in (up), i.e. (by implication) to satisfy (literally or figuratively). KJV: fill.

εμπιπτω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and πίπτω (G4098); to fall on, i.e. (literally) to be entrapped by, or (figuratively) be overwhelmed with. KJV: fall among (into).

εμπλεκω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and πλέκω (G4120); to entwine, i.e. (figuratively) involve with. KJV: entangle (in, self with).

εμπλοκη.def: from ἐμπλέκω (G1707); elaborate braiding of the hair. KJV: plaiting.

εμπνεω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and πνέω (G4154); to inhale, i.e. (figuratively) to be animated by (bent upon). KJV: breathe.

εμπορευομαι.def: from ἐν (G1722) and πορεύομαι (G4198); to travel in (a country as a pedlar), i.e. (by implication) to trade. KJV: buy and sell, make merchandise.

εμπορια.def: feminine from ἔμπορος (G1713); traffic. KJV: merchandise.

εμποριον.def: neuter from ἔμπορος (G1713); a mart ("emporium"). KJV: merchandise.

εμποροσ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and the base of πορεύομαι (G4198); a (wholesale) tradesman. KJV: merchant.

εμπρηθω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and πρήθω (to blow a flame); to enkindle, i.e. set on fire. KJV: burn up.

εμπροσθεν.def: from ἐν (G1722) and πρός (G4314); in front of (in place (literally or figuratively) or time). KJV: against, at, before, (in presence, sight) of.

εμπτυω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and πτύω (G4429); to spit at or on. KJV: spit (upon).

εμφανησ.def: from a compound of ἐν (G1722) and φαίνω (G5316); apparent in self. KJV: manifest, openly.

εμφανιζω.def: from ἐμφανής (G1717); to exhibit (in person) or disclose (by words). KJV: appear, declare (plainly), inform, (will) manifest, shew, signify.

εμφοβοσ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and φόβος (G5401); in fear, i.e. alarmed. KJV: affrighted, afraid, tremble.

εμφυσαω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and φυσάω (to puff) (compare φύω (G5453)); to blow at or on. KJV: breathe on.

εμφυτοσ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and a derivative of φύω (G5453); implanted (figuratively). KJV: engrafted.

εν.def: a primary preposition denoting (fixed) position (in place, time or state), and (by implication) instrumentality (medially or constructively), i.e. a relation of rest (intermediate between εἰς (G1519) and ἐκ (G1537)); "in," at, (up-)on, by, etc. KJV: about, after, against, + almost, X altogether, among, X as, at, before, between, (here-)by (+ all means), for (… sake of), + give self wholly to, (here-)in(-to, -wardly), X mightily, (because) of, (up-)on, (open-)ly, X outwardly, one, X quickly, X shortly, (speedi-)ly, X that, X there(-in, -on), through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), under, when, where(-with), while, with(-in).

εναγκαλιζομαι.def: from ἐν (G1722) and a derivative of ἀγκάλη (G43); to take in one's arms, i.e. embrace. KJV: take up in arms.

εναλιοσ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and ἅλς (G251); in the sea, i.e. marine. KJV: thing in the sea.

εναντι.def: from ἐν (G1722) and ἀντί (G473); in front (i.e. figuratively, presence) of. KJV: before.

εναντιον.def: neuter of ἐναντίος (G1727); (adverbially) in the presence (view) of. KJV: before, in the presence of.

εναντιοσ.def: from ἔναντι (G1725); opposite; figuratively, antagonistic. KJV: (over) against, contrary.

εναρχομαι.def: from ἐν (G1722) and ἄρχομαι (G756); to commence on. KJV: rule (by mistake for ἄρχω (G757)).

ενδεησ.def: from a compound of ἐν (G1722) and δέω (G1210) (in the sense of lacking); deficient in. KJV: lacking.

ενδειγμα.def: from ἐνδείκνυμι (G1731); an indication (concretely). KJV: manifest token.

ενδεικνυμι.def: from ἐν (G1722) and δεικνύω (G1166); to indicate (by word or act). KJV: do, show (forth).

ενδειξισ.def: from ἐνδείκνυμι (G1731); indication (abstractly). KJV: declare, evident token, proof.

ενδεκα.def: from (the neuter of) εἷς (G1520) and δέκα (G1176); one and ten, i.e. eleven. KJV: eleven.

ενδεκατοσ.def: ordinal from ἕνδεκα (G1733); eleventh. KJV: eleventh.

ενδεχεται.def: third person singular present of a compound of ἐν (G1722) and δέχομαι (G1209); (impersonally) it is accepted in, i.e. admitted (possible). KJV: can (+ not) be.

ενδημεω.def: from a compound of ἐν (G1722) and δῆμος (G1218); to be in one's own country, i.e. home (figuratively). KJV: be at home (present).

ενδιδυσκω.def: a prolonged form of ἐνδύω (G1746); to invest (with a garment). KJV: clothe in, wear.

ενδικοσ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and δίκη (G1349); in the right, i.e. equitable. KJV: just.

ενδομησισ.def: from a compound of ἐν (G1722) and a derivative of the base of δῆμος (G1218); a housing in (residence), i.e. structure. KJV: building.

ενδοξαζω.def: from ἔνδοξος (G1741); to glorify. KJV: glorify.

ενδοξοσ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and δόξα (G1391); in glory, i.e. splendid, (figuratively) noble. KJV: glorious, gorgeous(-ly), honourable.

ενδυμα.def: from ἐνδύω (G1746); apparel (especially the outer robe). KJV: clothing, garment, raiment.

ενδυναμοω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and δυναμόω (G1412); to empower. KJV: enable, (increase in) strength(-en), be (make) strong.

ενδυνω.def: from ἔννομος (G1772) and δύνω (G1416); to sink (by implication, wrap (compare ἐνδύω (G1746)) on, i.e. (figuratively) sneak. KJV: creep.

ενδυσισ.def: from ἐνδύω (G1746); investment with clothing. KJV: putting on.

ενδυω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and δύνω (G1416) (in the sense of sinking into a garment); to invest with clothing (literally or figuratively). KJV: array, clothe (with), endue, have (put) on.

ενεδρα.def: feminine from ἐν (G1722) and the base of ἑδραῖος (G1476); an ambuscade, i.e. (figuratively) murderous purpose. KJV: lay wait.

ενεδρευω.def: from ἐνέδρα (G1747); to lurk, i.e. (figuratively) plot assassination. KJV: lay wait for.

ενεδρον.def: neuter of the same as ἐνέδρα (G1747); an ambush, i.e. (figuratively) murderous design. KJV: lying in wait.

ενειλεω.def: from ἔννομος (G1772) and the base of εἱλίσσω (G1507); to enwrap. KJV: wrap in.

ενειμι.def: from ἔννομος (G1772) and εἰμί (G1510); to be within (neuter participle plural). KJV: such things as … have.

ενεκα.def: of uncertain affinity; on account of. KJV: because, for (cause, sake), (where-)fore, by reason of, that.

ενεργεια.def: from ἐνεργής (G1756); efficiency ("energy"). KJV: operation, strong, (effectual) working.

ενεργεω.def: from ἐνεργής (G1756); to be active, efficient. KJV: do, (be) effectual (fervent), be mighty in, shew forth self, work (effectually in).

ενεργημα.def: from ἐνεργέω (G1754); an effect. KJV: operation, working.

ενεργησ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and ἔργον (G2041); active, operative. KJV: effectual, powerful.

ενευλογεω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and εὐλογέω (G2127); to confer a benefit on. KJV: bless.

ενεχω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and ἔχω (G2192); to hold in or upon, i.e. ensnare; by implication, to keep a grudge. KJV: entangle with, have a quarrel against, urge.

ενθαδε.def: from a prolonged form of ἐν (G1722); properly, within, i.e. (of place) here, hither. KJV: (t-)here, hither.

ενθυμεομαι.def: from a compound of ἐν (G1722) and θυμός (G2372); to be inspirited, i.e. ponder. KJV: think.

ενθυμησισ.def: from ἐνθυμέομαι (G1760); deliberation. KJV: device, thought.

ενι.def: contraction for the third person singular present indicative of ἔνειμι (G1751); impersonally, there is in or among. KJV: be, (there) is.

ενιαυτοσ.def: prolongation from a primary ἔνος (a year); a year. KJV: year.

ενιστημι.def: from ἐν (G1722) and ἵστημι (G2476); to place on hand, i.e. (reflexively) impend, (participle) be instant. KJV: come, be at hand, present.

ενισχυω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and ἰσχύω (G2480); to invigorate (transitively or reflexively). KJV: strengthen.

εννατοσ.def: ordinal from ἐννέα (G1767); ninth. KJV: ninth.

εννεα.def: a primary number; nine. KJV: nine.

εννενηκονταεννεα.def: from a (tenth) multiple of ἐννέα (G1767) and ἐννέα (G1767) itself; ninety-nine. KJV: ninety and nine.

εννεοσ.def: from ἐννεύω (G1770); dumb (as making signs), i.e. silent from astonishment. KJV: speechless.

εννευω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and νεύω (G3506); to nod at, i.e. beckon or communicate by gesture. KJV: make signs.

εννοια.def: from a compound of ἐν (G1722) and νοῦς (G3563); thoughtfulness, i.e. moral understanding. KJV: intent, mind.

εννομοσ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and νόμος (G3551); (subjectively) legal, or (objectively) subject to. KJV: lawful, under law.

εννυχον.def: neuter of a compound of ἐν (G1722) and νύξ (G3571); (adverbially) by night. KJV: before day.

ενοικεω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and οἰκέω (G3611); to inhabit (figuratively). KJV: dwell in.

ενοτησ.def: from εἷς (G1520); oneness, i.e. (figuratively) unanimity. KJV: unity.

ενοχλεω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and ὀχλέω (G3791); to crowd in, i.e. (figuratively) to annoy. KJV: trouble.

ενοχοσ.def: from ἐνέχω (G1758); liable to (a condition, penalty or imputation). KJV: in danger of, guilty of, subject to.

ενταλμα.def: from ἐντέλλομαι (G1781); an injunction, i.e. religious precept. KJV: commandment.

ενταφιαζω.def: from a compound of ἐν (G1722) and τάφος (G5028); to inswathe with cerements for interment. KJV: bury.

ενταφιασμοσ.def: from ἐνταφιάζω (G1779); preparation for interment. KJV: burying.

εντελλομαι.def: from ἐν (G1722) and the base of τέλος (G5056); to enjoin. KJV: (give) charge, (give) command(-ments), injoin.

εντευθεν.def: from the same as ἐνθάδε (G1759); hence (literally or figuratively); (repeated) on both sides. KJV: (from) hence, on either side.

εντευξισ.def: from ἐντυγχάνω (G1793); an interview, i.e. (specially) supplication. KJV: intercession, prayer.

εντιμοσ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and τιμή (G5092); valued (figuratively). KJV: dear, more honourable, precious, in reputation.

εντολη.def: from ἐντέλλομαι (G1781); injunction, i.e. an authoritative prescription. KJV: commandment, precept.

εντοπιοσ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and τόπος (G5117); a resident. KJV: of that place.

εντοσ.def: from ἐν (G1722); inside (adverb or noun). KJV: within.

εντρεπω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and the base of τροπή (G5157); to invert, i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) in a good sense, to respect; or in a bad one, to confound. KJV: regard, (give) reference, shame.

εντρεφω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and τρέφω (G5142); (figuratively) to educate. KJV: nourish up in.

εντρομοσ.def: from ἐν (G1722) and τρόμος (G5156); terrified. KJV: X quake, X trembled.

εντρυφαω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and τρυφάω (G5171); to revel in. KJV: sporting selves.

εντυγχανω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and τυγχάνω (G5177); to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) confer with; by extension to entreat (in favor or against). KJV: deal with, make intercession.

εντυλισσω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and τυλίσσω (to twist; probably akin to εἱλίσσω (G1507)); to entwine, i.e. wind up in. KJV: wrap in (together).

εντυποω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and a derivative of τύπος (G5179); to enstamp, i.e. engrave. KJV: engrave.

ενυβριζω.def: from ἐν (G1722) and ὑβρίζω (G5195); to insult. KJV: do despite unto.

ενυπνιαζομαι.def: middle voice from ἐνύπνιον (G1798); to dream. KJV: dream(-er).

ενυπνιον.def: from ἐν (G1722) and ὕπνος (G5258); something seen in sleep, i.e. a dream (vision in a dream). KJV: dream.

ενωπιον.def: neuter of a compound of ἐν (G1722) and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι (G3700); in the face of (literally or figuratively). KJV: before, in the presence (sight) of, to.

ενωσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H583); Enos (i.e. Enosh), a patriarch. KJV: Enos.

ενωτιζομαι.def: middle voice from a compound of ἐν (G1722) and οὖς (G3775); to take in one's ear, i.e. to listen. KJV: hearken.

ενωχ.def: of Hebrew origin (H2585); Enoch (i.e. Chanok), an antediluvian. KJV: Enoch.

εξ.def: a primary numeral; six. KJV: six.

εξαγγελλω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and the base of ἄγγελος (G32); to publish, i.e. celebrate. KJV: shew forth.

εξαγοραζω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἀγοράζω (G59); to buy up, i.e. ransom; figuratively, to rescue from loss (improve opportunity). KJV: redeem.

εξαγω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἄγω (G71); to lead forth. KJV: bring forth (out), fetch (lead) out.

εξαιρεω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and αἱρέομαι (G138); actively, to tear out; middle voice, to select; figuratively, to release. KJV: deliver, pluck out, rescue.

εξαιρω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and αἴρω (G142); to remove. KJV: put (take) away.

εξαιτεομαι.def: middle voice from ἐκ (G1537) and αἰτέω (G154); to demand (for trial). KJV: desire.

εξαιφνησ.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and the base of αἰφνίδιος (G160); of a sudden (unexpectedly). KJV: suddenly.

εξακολουθεω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἀκολουθέω (G190); to follow out, i.e. (figuratively) to imitate, obey, yield to. KJV: follow.

εξακοσιοι.def: plural ordinal from ἕξ (G1803) and ἑκατόν (G1540); six hundred. KJV: six hundred.

εξαλειφω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἀλείφω (G218); to smear out, i.e. obliterate (erase tears, figuratively, pardon sin). KJV: blot out, wipe away.

εξαλλομαι.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἅλλομαι (G242); to spring forth. KJV: leap up.

εξαναστασισ.def: from ἐξανίστημι (G1817); a rising from death. KJV: resurrection.

εξανατελλω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἀνατέλλω (G393); to start up out of the ground, i.e. germinate. KJV: spring up.

εξανιστημι.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἀνίστημι (G450); objectively, to produce, i.e. (figuratively) beget; subjectively, to arise, i.e. (figuratively) object. KJV: raise (rise) up.

εξαπαταω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἀπατάω (G538); to seduce wholly. KJV: beguile, deceive.

εξαπινα.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and a derivative of the same as αἰφνίδιος (G160); of a sudden, i.e. unexpectedly. KJV: suddenly.

εξαπορεομαι.def: middle voice from ἐκ (G1537) and ἀπορέω (G639); to be utterly at a loss, i.e. despond. KJV: (in) despair.

εξαποστελλω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἀποστέλλω (G649); to send away forth, i.e. (on a mission) to despatch, or (peremptorily) to dismiss. KJV: send (away, forth, out).

εξαρτιζω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and a derivative of ἄρτιος (G739); to finish out (time); figuratively, to equip fully (a teacher). KJV: accomplish, thoroughly furnish.

εξαστραπτω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἀστράπτω (G797); to lighten forth, i.e. (figuratively) to be radiant (of very white garments). KJV: glistening.

εξαυτησ.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and the genitive case singular feminine of αὐτός (G846) (ὥρα (G5610) being understood); from that hour, i.e. instantly. KJV: by and by, immediately, presently, straightway.

εξεγειρω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἐγείρω (G1453); to rouse fully, i.e. (figuratively) to resuscitate (from death), release (from infliction). KJV: raise up.

εξειμι.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and εἶμι (to go); to issue, i.e. leave (a place), escape (to the shore). KJV: depart, get (to land), go out.

εξελεγχω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἐλέγχω (G1651); to convict fully, i.e. (by implication) to punish. KJV: convince.

εξελκω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἑλκύω (G1670); to drag forth, i.e. (figuratively) to entice (to sin). KJV: draw away.

εξεραμα.def: from a comparative of ἐκ (G1537) and a presumed ἐράω (to spue); vomit, i.e. food disgorged. KJV: vomit.

εξερευναω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἐρευνάω (G2045); to explore (figuratively). KJV: search diligently.

εξερχομαι.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἔρχομαι (G2064); to issue (literally or figuratively). KJV: come (forth, out), depart (out of), escape, get out, go (abroad, away, forth, out, thence), proceed (forth), spread abroad.

εξεστι.def: third person singular present indicative of a compound of ἐκ (G1537) and εἰμί (G1510); so also ἐξόν neuter present participle of the same (with or without some form of εἰμί (G1510) expressed); impersonally, it is right (through the figurative idea of being out in public). KJV: be lawful, let, X may(-est).

εξεταζω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἐτάζω (to examine); to test thoroughly (by questions), i.e. ascertain or interrogate. KJV: ask, enquire, search.

εξηγεομαι.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἡγέομαι (G2233); to consider out (aloud), i.e. rehearse, unfold. KJV: declare, tell.

εξηκοντα.def: the tenth multiple of ἕξ (G1803); sixty. KJV: sixty(-fold), threescore.

εξησ.def: from ἔχω (G2192) (in the sense of taking hold of, i.e. adjoining); successive. KJV: after, following, X morrow, next.

εξηχεομαι.def: middle voice from ἐκ (G1537) and ἠχέω (G2278); to "echo" forth, i.e. resound (be generally reported). KJV: sound forth.

εξισ.def: from ἔχω (G2192); habit, i.e. (by implication) practice. KJV: use.

εξιστημι.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἵστημι (G2476); to put (stand) out of wits, i.e. astound, or (reflexively) become astounded, insane. KJV: amaze, be (make) astonished, be beside self (selves), bewitch, wonder.

εξισχυω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ἰσχύω (G2480); to have full strength, i.e. be entirely competent. KJV: be able.

εξοδοσ.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ὁδός (G3598); an exit, i.e. (figuratively) death. KJV: decease, departing.

εξολοθρευω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ὀλοθρεύω (G3645); to extirpate. KJV: destroy.

εξομολογεω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ὁμολογέω (G3670); to acknowledge or (by implication, of assent) agree fully. KJV: confess, profess, promise.

εξορκιζω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ὁρκίζω (G3726); to exact an oath, i.e. conjure. KJV: adjure.

εξορκιστησ.def: from ἐξορκίζω (G1844); one that binds by an oath (or spell), i.e. (by implication) an "exorcist" (conjurer). KJV: exorcist.

εξορυσσω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ὀρύσσω (G3736); to dig out, i.e. (by extension) to extract (an eye), remove (roofing). KJV: break up, pluck out.

εξουδενοω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and a derivative of the neuter of οὐδείς (G3762); to make utterly nothing of, i.e. despise. KJV: set at nought.

εξουθενεω.def: a variation of ἐξουδενόω (G1847) and meaning the same. KJV: contemptible, despise, least esteemed, set at nought.

εξουσια.def: from ἔξεστι (G1832) (in the sense of ability); privilege, i.e. (subjectively) force, capacity, competency, freedom, or (objectively) mastery (concretely, magistrate, superhuman, potentate, token of control), delegated influence. KJV: authority, jurisdiction, liberty, power, right, strength.

εξουσιαζω.def: from ἐξουσία (G1849); to control. KJV: exercise authority upon, bring under the (have) power of.

εξοχη.def: from a compound of ἐκ (G1537) and ἔχω (G2192) (meaning to stand out); prominence (figuratively). KJV: principal.

εξυπνιζω.def: from ἔξυπνος (G1853); to waken. KJV: awake out of sleep.

εξυπνοσ.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ὕπνος (G5258); awake. KJV: X out of sleep.

εξω.def: adverb from ἐκ (G1537); out(-side, of doors), literally or figuratively. KJV: away, forth, (with-)out (of, -ward), strange.

εξωθεν.def: from ἔξω (G1854); external(-ly). KJV: out(-side, -ward, - wardly), (from) without.

εξωθεω.def: from ἐκ (G1537) and ὠθέω (to push); to expel; by implication, to propel. KJV: drive out, thrust in.

εξωτεροσ.def: comparative of ἔξω (G1854); exterior. KJV: outer.

εορταζω.def: from ἑορτή (G1859); to observe a festival. KJV: keep the feast.

εορτη.def: of uncertain affinity; a festival. KJV: feast, holyday.

επαγγελια.def: from ἐπαγγέλλω (G1861); an announcement (for information, assent or pledge; especially a divine assurance of good). KJV: message, promise.

επαγγελλω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and the base of ἄγγελος (G32); to announce upon (reflexively), i.e. (by implication) to engage to do something, to assert something respecting oneself. KJV: profess, (make) promise.

επαγγελμα.def: from ἐπαγγέλλω (G1861); a self-committal (by assurance of conferring some good). KJV: promise.

επαγω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἄγω (G71); to superinduce, i.e. inflict (an evil), charge (a crime). KJV: bring upon.

επαγωνιζομαι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἀγωνίζομαι (G75); to struggle for. KJV: earnestly contend for.

επαθροιζω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἀθροίζω (to assemble); to accumulate. KJV: gather thick together.

επαινετοσ.def: from ἐπαινέω (G1867); praised; Epænetus, a Christian. KJV: Epenetus.

επαινεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and αἰνέω (G134); to applaud. KJV: commend, laud, praise.

επαινοσ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and the base of αἰνέω (G134); laudation; concretely, a commendable thing. KJV: praise.

επαιρω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and αἴρω (G142); to raise up (literally or figuratively). KJV: exalt self, poise (lift, take) up.

επαισχυνομαι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and αἰσχύνομαι (G153); to feel shame for something. KJV: be ashamed.

επαιτεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and αἰτέω (G154); to ask for. KJV: beg.

επακολουθεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἀκολουθέω (G190); to accompany. KJV: follow (after).

επακουω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἀκούω (G191); to hearken (favorably) to. KJV: hear.

επακροαομαι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and the base of ἀκροατής (G202); to listen (intently) to. KJV: hear.

επαν.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἄν (G302); a particle of indefinite contemporaneousness; whenever, as soon as. KJV: when.

επαναγκεσ.def: neuter of a presumed compound of ἐπί (G1909) and ἀνάγκη (G318); (adverbially) on necessity, i.e. necessarily. KJV: necessary.

επαναγω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἀνάγω (G321); to lead up on, i.e. (technical) to put out (to sea); (intransitively) to return. KJV: launch (thrust) out, return.

επαναμιμνησκω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἀναμιμνήσκω (G363); to remind of. KJV: put in mind.

επαναπαυομαι.def: middle voice from ἐπί (G1909) and ἀναπαύω (G373); to settle on; literally (remain) or figuratively (rely). KJV: rest in (upon).

επανερχομαι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἀνέρχομαι (G424); to come up on, i.e. return. KJV: come again, return.

επανισταμαι.def: middle voice from ἐπί (G1909) and ἀνίστημι (G450); to stand up on, i.e. (figuratively) to attack. KJV: rise up against.

επανορθωσισ.def: from a compound of ἐπί (G1909) and ἀνορθόω (G461); a straightening up again, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (reformation). KJV: correction.

επανω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἄνω (G507); up above, i.e. over or on (of place, amount, rank, etc.). KJV: above, more than, (up-)on, over.

επαρκεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἀρκέω (G714); to avail for, i.e. help. KJV: relieve.

επαρχια.def: from a compound of ἐπί (G1909) and ἄρχω (G757) (meaning a governor of a district, "eparch"); a special region of government, i.e. a Roman præfecture. KJV: province.

επαυλισ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and an equivalent of αὐλή (G833); a hut over the head, i.e. a dwelling. KJV: habitation.

επαυριον.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and αὔριον (G839); occurring on the succeeding day, i.e. (ἡμέρα (G2250) being implied) to-morrow. KJV: day following, morrow, next day (after).

επαυτοφωρω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and αὐτός (G846) and (the dative case singular of) a derivative of φώρ (a thief); in theft itself, i.e. (by analogy) in actual crime. KJV: in the very act.

επαφρασ.def: contracted from Ἐπαφρόδιτος (G1891); Epaphras, a Christian. KJV: Epaphras.

επαφριζω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἀφρίζω (G875); to foam upon, i.e. (figuratively) to exhibit (a vile passion). KJV: foam out.

επαφροδιτοσ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) (in the sense of devoted to) and Ἀφροδίτη (Venus); Epaphroditus, a Christian. KJV: Epaphroditus.

επεγειρω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἐγείρω (G1453); to rouse upon, i.e. (figuratively) to excite against. KJV: raise, stir up.

επει.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and εἰ (G1487); thereupon, i.e. since (of time or cause). KJV: because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing that, since, when.

επειδη.def: from ἐπεί (G1893) and δή (G1211); since now, i.e. (of time) when, or (of cause) whereas. KJV: after that, because, for (that, -asmuch as), seeing, since.

επειδηπερ.def: from ἐπειδή (G1894) and περ (G4007); since indeed (of cause). KJV: forasmuch.

επειδον.def: and other moods and persons of the same tense; from ἐπί (G1909) and εἴδω (G1492); to regard (favorably or otherwise). KJV: behold, look upon.

επειπερ.def: from ἐπεί (G1893) and περ (G4007); since indeed (of cause). KJV: seeing.

επεισαγωγη.def: from a compound of ἐπί (G1909) and εἰσάγω (G1521); a superintroduction. KJV: bringing in.

επειτα.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and εἶτα (G1534); thereafter. KJV: after that(-ward), then.

επεκεινα.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and (the accusative case plural neuter of) ἐκεῖνος (G1565); upon those parts of, i.e. on the further side of. KJV: beyond.

επεκτεινομαι.def: middle voice from ἐπί (G1909) and ἐκτείνω (G1614); to stretch (oneself) forward upon. KJV: reach forth.

επενδυομαι.def: middle voice from ἐπί (G1909) and ἐνδύω (G1746); to invest upon oneself. KJV: be clothed upon.

επενδυτησ.def: from ἐπενδύομαι (G1902); a wrapper, i.e. outer garment. KJV: fisher's coat.

επερχομαι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἔρχομαι (G2064); to supervene, i.e. arrive, occur, impend, attack, (figuratively) influence. KJV: come (in, upon).

επερωταω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἐρωτάω (G2065); to ask for, i.e. inquire, seek. KJV: ask (after, questions), demand, desire, question.

επερωτημα.def: from ἐπερωτάω (G1905); an inquiry. KJV: answer.

επεχω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἔχω (G2192); to hold upon, i.e. (by implication) to retain; (by extension) to detain; (with implication, of νοῦς (G3563)) to pay attention to. KJV: give (take) heed unto, hold forth, mark, stay.

επηρεαζω.def: from a comparative of ἐπί (G1909) and (probably) ἀρειά (threats); to insult, slander. KJV: use despitefully, falsely accuse.

επι.def: a primary preposition; properly, meaning superimposition (of time, place, order, etc.), as a relation of distribution (with the genitive case), i.e. over, upon, etc.; of rest (with the dative case) at, on, etc.; of direction (with the accusative case) towards, upon, etc. KJV: about (the times), above, after, against, among, as long as (touching), at, beside, X have charge of, (be-, (where-))fore, in (a place, as much as, the time of, -to), (because) of, (up-)on (behalf of), over, (by, for) the space of, through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), with.

επιβαινω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and the base of βάσις (G939); to walk upon, i.e. mount, ascend, embark, arrive. KJV: come (into), enter into, go abroad, sit upon, take ship.

επιβαλλω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and βάλλω (G906); to throw upon (literal or figurative, transitive or reflexive; usually with more or less force); specially (with ἑαυτοῦ (G1438) implied) to reflect; impersonally, to belong to. KJV: beat into, cast (up-)on, fall, lay (on), put (unto), stretch forth, think on.

επιβαρεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and βαρέω (G916); to be heavy upon, i.e. (pecuniarily) to be expensive to; figuratively, to be severe towards. KJV: be chargeable to, overcharge.

επιβιβαζω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and a reduplicated derivative of the base of βάσις (G939) (compare ἀναβιβάζω (G307)); to cause to mount (an animal). KJV: set on.

επιβλεπω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and βλέπω (G991); to gaze at (with favor, pity or partiality). KJV: look upon, regard, have respect to.

επιβλημα.def: from ἐπιβάλλω (G1911); a patch. KJV: piece.

επιβοαω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and βοάω (G994); to exclaim against. KJV: cry.

επιβουλη.def: from a presumed compound of ἐπί (G1909) and βούλομαι (G1014); a plan against someone, i.e. a plot. KJV: laying (lying) in wait.

επιγαμβρευω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and a derivative of γάμος (G1062); to form affinity with, i.e. (specially) in a levirate way. KJV: marry.

επιγειοσ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and γῆ (G1093); worldly (physically or morally). KJV: earthly, in earth, terrestrial.

επιγινομαι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and γίνομαι (G1096); to arrive upon, i.e. spring up (as a wind). KJV: blow.

επιγινωσκω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and γινώσκω (G1097); to know upon some mark, i.e. recognize; by implication, to become fully acquainted with, to acknowledge. KJV: (ac-, have, take)know(-ledge, well), perceive.

επιγνωσισ.def: from ἐπιγινώσκω (G1921); recognition, i.e. (by implication) full discernment, acknowledgement. KJV: (ac-)knowledge(-ing, - ment).

επιγραφη.def: from ἐπιγράφω (G1924); an inscription. KJV: superscription.

επιγραφω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and γράφω (G1125); to inscribe (physically or mentally). KJV: inscription, write in (over, thereon).

επιδεικνυμι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and δεικνύω (G1166); to exhibit (physically or mentally). KJV: shew.

επιδεχομαι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and δέχομαι (G1209); to admit (as a guest or (figuratively) teacher). KJV: receive.

επιδημεω.def: from a compound of ἐπί (G1909) and δῆμος (G1218); to make oneself at home, i.e. (by extension) to reside (in a foreign country). KJV: (be) dwelling (which were) there, stranger.

επιδιατασσομαι.def: middle voice from ἐπί (G1909) and διατάσσω (G1299); to appoint besides, i.e. supplement (as a codicil). KJV: add to.

επιδιδωμι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and δίδωμι (G1325); to give over (by hand or surrender). KJV: deliver unto, give, let (+ (her drive)), offer.

επιδιορθοω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and a derivative of ὀρθός (G3717); to straighten further, i.e. (figuratively) arrange additionally. KJV: set in order.

επιδυω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and δύνω (G1416); to set fully (as the sun). KJV: go down.

επιεικεια.def: from ἐπιεικής (G1933); suitableness, i.e. (by implication) equity, mildness. KJV: clemency, gentleness.

επιεικησ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and εἴκω (G1503); appropriate, i.e. (by implication) mild. KJV: gentle, moderation, patient.

επιζητεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ζητέω (G2212); to search (inquire) for; intensively, to demand, to crave. KJV: desire, enquire, seek (after, for).

επιθανατιοσ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and θάνατος (G2288); doomed to death. KJV: appointed to death.

επιθεσισ.def: from ἐπιτίθημι (G2007); an imposition (of hands officially). KJV: laying (putting) on.

επιθυμεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and θυμός (G2372); to set the heart upon, i.e. long for (rightfully or otherwise). KJV: covet, desire, would fain, lust (after).

επιθυμητησ.def: from ἐπιθυμέω (G1937); a craver. KJV: + lust after.

επιθυμια.def: from ἐπιθυμέω (G1937); a longing (especially for what is forbidden). KJV: concupiscence, desire, lust (after).

επικαθιζω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and καθίζω (G2523); to seat upon. KJV: set on.

επικαλεομαι.def: middle voice from ἐπί (G1909) and καλέω (G2564); to entitle; by implication, to invoke (for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.). KJV: appeal (unto), call (on, upon), surname.

επικαλυμα.def: from ἐπικαλύπτω (G1943); a covering, i.e. (figuratively) pretext. KJV: cloke.

επικαλυπτω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and καλύπτω (G2572); to conceal, i.e. (figuratively) forgive. KJV: cover.

επικαταρατοσ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and a derivative of καταράομαι (G2672); imprecated, i.e. execrable. KJV: accursed.

επικειμαι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and κεῖμαι (G2749); to rest upon (literally or figuratively). KJV: impose, be instant, (be) laid (there-, up-)on, (when) lay (on), lie (on), press upon.

επικουρειοσ.def: from Ἐπίκουρος (compare ἐπικουρία (G1947)) (a noted philosopher); an Epicurean or follower of Epicurus. KJV: Epicurean.

επικουρια.def: from a compound of ἐπί (G1909) and a (prolonged) form of the base of κοράσιον (G2877) (in the sense of servant); assistance. KJV: help.

επικρινω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and κρίνω (G2919); to adjudge. KJV: give sentence.

επιλαμβανομαι.def: middle voice from ἐπί (G1909) and λαμβάνω (G2983); to seize (for help, injury, attainment, or any other purpose; literally or figuratively). KJV: catch, lay hold (up-)on, take (by, hold of, on).

επιλανθανομαι.def: middle voice from ἐπί (G1909) and λανθάνω (G2990); to lose out of mind; by implication, to neglect. KJV: (be) forget(-ful of).

επιλεγομαι.def: middle voice from ἐπί (G1909) and λέγω (G3004); to surname, select. KJV: call, choose.

επιλειπω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and λείπω (G3007); to leave upon, i.e. (figuratively) to be insufficient for. KJV: fail.

επιλησμονη.def: from a derivative of ἐπιλανθάνομαι (G1950); negligence. KJV: X forgetful.

επιλοιποσ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and λοιποί (G3062); left over, i.e. remaining. KJV: rest.

επιλυσισ.def: from ἐπιλύω (G1956); explanation, i.e. application. KJV: interpretation.

επιλυω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and λύω (G3089); to solve further, i.e. (figuratively) to explain, decide. KJV: determine, expound.

επιμαρτυρεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and μαρτυρέω (G3140); to attest further, i.e. corroborate. KJV: testify.

επιμελεια.def: from ἐπιμελέομαι (G1959); carefulness, i.e. kind attention (hospitality). KJV: + refresh self.

επιμελεομαι.def: middle voice from ἐπί (G1909) and the same as μέλω (G3199); to care for (physically or otherwise). KJV: take care of.

επιμελωσ.def: adverb from a derivative of ἐπιμελέομαι (G1959); carefully. KJV: diligently.

επιμενω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and μένω (G3306); to stay over, i.e. remain (figuratively, persevere). KJV: abide (in), continue (in), tarry.

επινευω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and νεύω (G3506); to nod at, i.e. (by implication) to assent. KJV: consent.

επινοια.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and νοῦς (G3563); attention of the mind, i.e. (by implication) purpose. KJV: thought.

επιορκεω.def: from ἐπίορκος (G1965); to commit perjury. KJV: forswear self.

επιορκοσ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ὅρκος (G3727); on oath, i.e. (falsely) a forswearer. KJV: perjured person.

επιουσα.def: feminine singular participle of a comparative of ἐπί (G1909) and εἶμι (to go); supervening, i.e. (ἡμέρα (G2250) or νύξ (G3571) being expressed or implied) the ensuing day or night. KJV: following, next.

επιουσιοσ.def: perhaps from the same as ἐπιοῦσα (G1966); tomorrow's; but more probably from ἐπί (G1909) and a derivative of the present participle feminine of εἰμί (G1510); for subsistence, i.e. needful. KJV: daily.

επιπιπτω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and πίπτω (G4098); to embrace (with affection) or seize (with more or less violence; literally or figuratively). KJV: fall into (on, upon) lie on, press upon.

επιπλησσω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and πλήσσω (G4141); to chastise, i.e. (with words) to upbraid. KJV: rebuke.

επιπνιγω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and πνίγω (G4155); to throttle upon, i.e. (figuratively) overgrow. KJV: choke.

επιποθεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and potheo (to yearn); to dote upon, i.e. intensely crave possession (lawfully or wrongfully). KJV: (earnestly) desire (greatly), (greatly) long (after), lust.

επιποθησισ.def: from ἐπιποθέω (G1971); a longing for. KJV: earnest (vehement) desire.

επιποθητοσ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and a derivative of the latter part of ἐπιποθέω (G1971); yearned upon, i.e. greatly loved. KJV: longed for.

επιποθια.def: from ἐπιποθέω (G1971); intense longing. KJV: great desire.

επιπορευομαι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and πορεύομαι (G4198); to journey further, i.e. travel on (reach). KJV: come.

επιρραπτω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and the base of ῥαφίς (G4476); to stitch upon, i.e. fasten with the needle. KJV: sew on.

επιρριπτω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ῥίπτω (G4496); to throw upon (literally or figuratively). KJV: cast upon.

επισημοσ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and some form of the base of σημαίνω (G4591); remarkable, i.e. (figuratively) eminent. KJV: notable, of note.

επισιτισμοσ.def: from a compound of ἐπί (G1909) and a derivative of σῖτος (G4621); a provisioning, i.e. (concretely) food. KJV: victuals.

επισκεπτομαι.def: middle voice from ἐπί (G1909) and the base of σκοπός (G4649); to inspect, i.e. (by implication) to select; by extension, to go to see, relieve. KJV: look out, visit.

επισκηνοω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and σκηνόω (G4637); to tent upon, i.e. (figuratively) abide with. KJV: rest upon.

επισκιαζω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and a derivative of σκιά (G4639); to cast a shade upon, i.e. (by analogy) to envelop in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively, to invest with preternatural influence. KJV: overshadow.

επισκοπεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and σκοπέω (G4648); to oversee; by implication, to beware. KJV: look diligently, take the oversight.

επισκοπη.def: from ἐπισκέπτομαι (G1980); inspection (for relief); by implication, superintendence; specially, the Christian "episcopate". KJV: the office of a "bishop", bishoprick, visitation.

επισκοποσ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and σκοπός (G4649) (in the sense of ἐπισκοπέω (G1983)); a superintendent, i.e. Christian officer in genitive case charge of a (or the) church (literally or figuratively). KJV: bishop, overseer.

επισπαομαι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and σπάω (G4685); to draw over, i.e. (with ἀκροβυστία (G203) implied) efface the mark of circumcision (by recovering with the foreskin). KJV: become uncircumcised.

επισταμαι.def: apparently a middle voice of ἐφίστημι (G2186) (with νοῦς (G3563) implied); to put the mind upon, i.e. comprehend, or be acquainted with. KJV: know, understand.

επιστατησ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and a presumed derivative of ἵστημι (G2476); an appointee over, i.e. commander (teacher). KJV: master.

επιστελλω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and στέλλω (G4724); to enjoin (by writing), i.e. (genitive case) to communicate by letter (for any purpose). KJV: write (a letter, unto).

επιστημων.def: from ἐπίσταμαι (G1987); intelligent. KJV: endued with knowledge.

επιστηριζω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and στηρίζω (G4741); to support further, i.e. reestablish. KJV: confirm, strengthen.

επιστολη.def: from ἐπιστέλλω (G1989); a written message. KJV: "epistle," letter.

επιστομιζω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and στόμα (G4750); to put something over the mouth, i.e. (figuratively) to silence. KJV: stop mouths.

επιστρεφω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and στρέφω (G4762); to revert (literally, figuratively or morally). KJV: come (go) again, convert, (re-)turn (about, again).

επιστροφη.def: from ἐπιστρέφω (G1994); reversion, i.e. morally, revolution. KJV: conversion.

επισυναγω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and συνάγω (G4863); to collect upon the same place. KJV: gather (together).

επισυναγωγη.def: from ἐπισυνάγω (G1996); a complete collection; especially a Christian meeting (for worship). KJV: assembling (gathering) together.

επισυντρεχω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and συντρέχω (G4936); to hasten together upon one place (or a particular occasion). KJV: come running together.

επισυστασισ.def: from the middle voice of a compound of ἐπί (G1909) and συνιστάω (G4921); a conspiracy, i.e. concourse (riotous or friendly). KJV: that which cometh upon, + raising up.

επισφαλησ.def: from a compound of ἐπί (G1909) and σφάλλω (to trip); figuratively, insecure. KJV: dangerous.

επισχυω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἰσχύω (G2480); to avail further, i.e. (figuratively) insist stoutly. KJV: be the more fierce.

επισωρευω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and σωρεύω (G4987); to accumulate further, i.e. (figuratively) seek additionally. KJV: heap.

επιταγη.def: from ἐπιτάσσω (G2004); an injunction or decree; by implication, authoritativeness. KJV: authority, commandment.

επιτασσω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and τάσσω (G5021); to arrange upon, i.e. order. KJV: charge, command, injoin.

επιτελεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and τελέω (G5055); to fulfill further (or completely), i.e. execute; by implication, to terminate, undergo. KJV: accomplish, do, finish, (make) (perfect), perform(X -ance).

επιτηδειοσ.def: from ἐπιτηδές (enough); serviceable, i.e. (by implication) requisite. KJV: things which are needful.

επιτιθημι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and τίθημι (G5087); to impose (in a friendly or hostile sense). KJV: add unto, lade, lay upon, put (up) on, set on (up), + surname, X wound.

επιτιμαω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and τιμάω (G5091); to tax upon, i.e. censure or admonish; by implication, forbid. KJV: (straitly) charge, rebuke.

επιτιμια.def: from a compound of ἐπί (G1909) and τιμή (G5092); properly, esteem, i.e. citizenship; used (in the sense of ἐπιτιμάω (G2008)) of a penalty. KJV: punishment.

επιτρεπω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and the base of τροπή (G5157); to turn over (transfer), i.e. allow. KJV: give leave (liberty, license), let, permit, suffer.

επιτροπη.def: from ἐπιτρέπω (G2010); permission, i.e. (by implication) full power. KJV: commission.

επιτροποσ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and τρόπος (G5158) (in the sense of ἐπιτροπή (G2011)); a commissioner, i.e. domestic manager, guardian. KJV: steward, tutor.

επιτυγχανω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and τυγχάνω (G5177); to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) to attain. KJV: obtain.

επιφαινω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and φαίνω (G5316); to shine upon, i.e. become (literally) visible or (figuratively) known. KJV: appear, give light.

επιφανεια.def: from ἐπιφανής (G2016); a manifestation, i.e. (specially) the advent of Christ (past or future). KJV: appearing, brightness.

επιφανησ.def: from ἐπιφαίνω (G2014); conspicuous, i.e. (figuratively) memorable. KJV: notable.

επιφαυω.def: a form of ἐπιφαίνω (G2014); to illuminate (figuratively). KJV: give light.

επιφερω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and φέρω (G5342); to bear upon (or further), i.e. adduce (personally or judicially (accuse, inflict)), superinduce. KJV: add, bring (against), take.

επιφωνεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and φωνέω (G5455); to call at something, i.e. exclaim. KJV: cry (against), give a shout.

επιφωσκω.def: a form of ἐπιφαύω (G2017); to begin to grow light. KJV: begin to dawn, X draw on.

επιχειρεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and χείρ (G5495); to put the hand upon, i.e. undertake. KJV: go about, take in hand (upon).

επιχεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and χέω (to pour);. KJV: to pour upon:--pour in.

επιχορηγεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and χορηγέω (G5524); to furnish besides, i.e. fully supply, (figuratively) aid or contribute. KJV: add, minister (nourishment, unto).

επιχριω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and χρίω (G5548); to smear over. KJV: anoint.

εποικοδομεω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and οἰκοδομέω (G3618); to build upon, i.e. (figuratively) to rear up. KJV: build thereon (thereupon, on, upon).

εποκελλω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ὀκέλλω (to urge); to drive upon the shore, i.e. to beach a vessel. KJV: run aground.

επονομαζω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ὀνομάζω (G3687); to name further, i.e. denominate. KJV: call.

εποπτευω.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι (G3700); to inspect, i.e. watch. KJV: behold.

εποπτησ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and a presumed derivative of ὀπτάνομαι (G3700); a looker-on. KJV: eye-witness.

εποσ.def: from ἔπω (G2036); a word. KJV: X say.

επουρανιοσ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and οὐρανός (G3772); above the sky. KJV: celestial, (in) heaven(-ly), high.

επτα.def: a primary number; seven. KJV: seven.

επτακισ.def: adverb from ἑπτά (G2033); seven times. KJV: seven times.

επτακισχιλιοι.def: from ἑπτάκις (G2034) and χίλιοι (G5507); seven times a thousand. KJV: seven thousand.

επω.def: a primary verb (used only in the definite past tense, the others being borrowed from ἐρέω (G2046), ῥέω (G4483), and φημί (G5346)); to speak or say (by word or writing). KJV: answer, bid, bring word, call, command, grant, say (on), speak, tell.

εραστοσ.def: from ἐράω (to love); beloved; Erastus, a Christian. KJV: Erastus.

εργαζομαι.def: middle voice from ἔργον (G2041); to toil (as a task, occupation, etc.), (by implication) effect, be engaged in or with, etc. KJV: commit, do, labor for, minister about, trade (by), work.

εργασια.def: from ἐργάτης (G2040); occupation; by implication, profit, pains. KJV: craft, diligence, gain, work.

εργατησ.def: from ἔργον (G2041); a toiler; figuratively, a teacher. KJV: labourer, worker(-men).

εργον.def: from a primary (but obsolete) ἔργω (to work); toil (as an effort or occupation); by implication, an act. KJV: deed, doing, labour, work.

ερεθιζω.def: from a presumed prolonged form of ἔρις (G2054); to stimulate (especially to anger). KJV: provoke.

ερειδω.def: of obscure affinity; to prop, i.e. (reflexively) get fast. KJV: stick fast.

ερευγομαι.def: of uncertain affinity; to belch, i.e. (figuratively) to speak out. KJV: utter.

ερευναω.def: apparently from ἐρέω (G2046) (through the idea of inquiry); to seek, i.e. (figuratively) to investigate. KJV: search.

ερεω.def: probably a fuller form of ῥέω (G4483); an alternate for ἔπω (G2036) in certain tenses; to utter, i.e. speak or say. KJV: call, say, speak (of), tell.

ερημια.def: from ἔρημος (G2048); solitude (concretely). KJV: desert, wilderness.

ερημοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; lonesome, i.e. (by implication) waste (usually as a noun, χώρα (G5561) being implied). KJV: desert, desolate, solitary, wilderness.

ερημοω.def: from ἔρημος (G2048); to lay waste (literally or figuratively). KJV: (bring to, make) desolate(-ion), come to nought.

εριζω.def: from ἔρις (G2054); to wrangle. KJV: strive.

εριθεια.def: perhaps as the same as ἐρεθίζω (G2042); properly, intrigue, i.e. (by implication) faction. KJV: contention(-ious), strife.

εριον.def: of obscure affinity; wool. KJV: wool.

ερισ.def: of uncertain affinity; a quarrel, i.e. (by implication) wrangling. KJV: contention, debate, strife, variance.

εριφιον.def: from ἔριφος (G2056); a kidling, i.e. (genitive case) goat (symbolically, wicked person). KJV: goat.

εριφοσ.def: perhaps from the same as ἔριον (G2053) (through the idea of hairiness); a kid or (genitive case) goat. KJV: goat, kid.

ερμασ.def: probably from Ἑρμῆς (G2060); Hermas, a Christian. KJV: Hermas.

ερμηνεια.def: from the same as ἑρμηνεύω (G2059); translation. KJV: interpretation.

ερμηνευω.def: from a presumed derivative of Ἑρμῆς (G2060) (as the god of language); to translate. KJV: interpret.

ερμησ.def: perhaps from ἐρέω (G2046); Hermes, the name of the messenger of the Greek deities; also of a Christian. KJV: Hermes, Mercury.

ερμογενησ.def: from Ἑρμῆς (G2060) and γίνομαι (G1096); born of Hermes; Hermogenes, an apostate Christian. KJV: Hermogenes.

ερπετον.def: neuter of a derivative of ἕρπω (to creep); a reptile, i.e. (by Hebraism (compare H7431)) a small animal. KJV: creeping thing, serpent.

ερυθροσ.def: of uncertain affinity; red, i.e. (with θάλασσα (G2281)) the Red Sea. KJV: red.

ερχομαι.def: middle voice of a primary verb (used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being supplied by a kindred (middle voice) ἐλεύθομαι, or (active) ἔλθω, which do not otherwise occur); to come or go (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively). KJV: accompany, appear, bring, come, enter, fall out, go, grow, X light, X next, pass, resort, be set.

ερωταω.def: apparently from ἐρέω (G2046) (compare ἐρευνάω (G2045)); to interrogate; by implication, to request. KJV: ask, beseech, desire, intreat, pray.

εσθησ.def: from ἕννυμι (to clothe); dress. KJV: apparel, clothing, raiment, robe.

εσθησισ.def: from a derivative of ἐσθής (G2066); clothing (concretely). KJV: government.

εσθιω.def: strengthened for a primary ἔδω (to eat); used only in certain tenses, the rest being supplied by φάγω (G5315); to eat (usually literal). KJV: devour, eat, live.

εσλι.def: of Hebrew origin (probably for H454); Esli, an Israelite. KJV: Esli.

εσμεν.def: first person plural indicative of εἰμί (G1510); we are. KJV: are, be, have our being, X have hope, + (the gospel) was (preached unto) us.

εσομαι.def: future of εἰμί (G1510); will be. KJV: shall (should) be (have), (shall) come (to pass), X may have, X fall, what would follow, X live long, X sojourn.

εσοπτρον.def: from εἰς (G1519) and a presumed derivative of ὀπτάνομαι (G3700); a mirror (for looking into). KJV: glass.

εσπερα.def: feminine of an adjective hesperos (evening); the eve (ὥρα (G5610) being implied). KJV: evening(-tide).

εσρωμ.def: of Hebrew origin (H2696); Esrom (i.e. Chetsron), an Israelite. KJV: Esrom.

εστε.def: second person plural present indicative of εἰμί (G1510); ye are. KJV: be, have been, belong.

εστι.def: third person singular present indicative of εἰμί (G1510); he (she or it) is; also (with neuter plural) they are. KJV: are, be(-long), call, X can(-not), come, consisteth, X dure for a while, + follow, X have, (that) is (to say), make, meaneth, X must needs, + profit, + remaineth, + wrestle.

εστω.def: second person singular present imperative of εἰμί (G1510); be thou; also ἔστωσαν, third person of the same; let them be. KJV: be.

εσχατοσ.def: a superlative probably from ἔχω (G2192) (in the sense of contiguity); farthest, final (of place or time). KJV: ends of, last, latter end, lowest, uttermost.
