εσχατωσ.def: adverb from ἔσχατος (G2078); finally, i.e. (with ἔχω (G2192)) at the extremity of life. KJV: point of death.

εσω.def: from εἰς (G1519); inside (as preposition or adjective). KJV: (with-)in(-ner, -to, -ward).

εσωθεν.def: from ἔσω (G2080); from inside; also used as equivalent to ἔσω (G2080) (inside). KJV: inward(-ly), (from) within, without.

εσωτεροσ.def: comparative of ἔσω (G2080); interior. KJV: inner, within.

εταιροσ.def: from ἔτης (a clansman); a comrade. KJV: fellow, friend.

ετερογλωσσοσ.def: from ἕτερος (G2087) and γλῶσσα (G1100); other- tongued, i.e. a foreigner. KJV: man of other tongue.

ετεροδιδασκαλεω.def: from ἕτερος (G2087) and διδάσκαλος (G1320); to instruct differently. KJV: teach other doctrine(-wise).

ετεροζυγεω.def: from a compound of ἕτερος (G2087) and ζυγός (G2218); to yoke up differently, i.e. (figuratively) to associate discordantly. KJV: unequally yoke together with.

ετεροσ.def: of uncertain affinity; (an-, the) other or different. KJV: altered, else, next (day), one, (an-)other, some, strange.

ετερωσ.def: adverb from ἕτερος (G2087); differently. KJV: otherwise.

ετι.def: perhaps akin to ἔτος (G2094); "yet," still (of time or degree). KJV: after that, also, ever, (any) further, (t-)henceforth (more), hereafter, (any) longer, (any) more(-one), now, still, yet.

ετοιμαζω.def: from ἕτοιμος (G2092); to prepare. KJV: prepare, provide, make ready.

ετοιμοσ.def: from an old noun ἐτεός (fitness); adjusted, i.e. ready. KJV: prepared, (made) ready(-iness, to our hand).

ετοιμωσ.def: adverb from ἕτοιμος (G2092); in readiness. KJV: ready.

ετοσ.def: apparently a primary word; a year. KJV: year.

ευ.def: neuter of a primary εὖς (good); (adverbially) well. KJV: good, well (done).

ευα.def: of Hebrew origin (H2332); Eua (or Eva, i.e. Chavvah), the first woman. KJV: Eve.

ευαγγελιζω.def: from εὖ (G2095) and ἄγγελος (G32); to announce good news ("evangelize") especially the gospel. KJV: declare, bring (declare, show) glad (good) tidings, preach (the gospel).

ευαγγελιον.def: from the same as εὐαγγελίζω (G2097); a good message, i.e. the gospel. KJV: gospel.

ευαγγελιστησ.def: from εὐαγγελίζω (G2097); a preacher of the gospel. KJV: evangelist.

ευαρεστεω.def: from εὐάρεστος (G2101); to gratify entirely. KJV: please (well).

ευαρεστοσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and ἀρεστός (G701); fully agreeable. KJV: acceptable(-ted), wellpleasing.

ευαρεστωσ.def: adverb from εὐάρεστος (G2101); quite agreeably. KJV: acceptably, + please well.

ευβουλοσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and βούλομαι (G1014); good-willer; Eubulus, a Christian. KJV: Eubulus.

ευγενησ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and γίνομαι (G1096); well born, i.e. (literally) high in rank, or (figuratively) generous. KJV: more noble, nobleman.

ευδια.def: feminine from εὖ (G2095) and the alternate of Ζεύς (G2203) (as the god of the weather); a clear sky, i.e. fine weather. KJV: fair weather.

ευδοκεω.def: from εὖ (G2095) and δοκέω (G1380); to think well of, i.e. approve (an act); specially, to approbate (a person or thing). KJV: think good, (be well) please(-d), be the good (have, take) pleasure, be willing.

ευδοκια.def: from a presumed compound of εὖ (G2095) and the base of δοκέω (G1380); satisfaction, i.e. (subjectively) delight, or (objectively) kindness, wish, purpose. KJV: desire, good pleasure (will), X seem good.

ευεργεσια.def: from εὐεργέτης (G2110); beneficence (genitive case or specially). KJV: benefit, good deed done.

ευεργετεω.def: from εὐεργέτης (G2110); to be philanthropic. KJV: do good.

ευεργετησ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and the base of ἔργον (G2041); a worker of good, i.e. (specially) a philanthropist. KJV: benefactor.

ευθετοσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and a derivative of τίθημι (G5087); well placed, i.e. (figuratively) appropriate. KJV: fit, meet.

ευθεωσ.def: adverb from εὐθύς (G2117); directly, i.e. at once or soon. KJV: anon, as soon as, forthwith, immediately, shortly, straightway.

ευθυδρομεω.def: from εὐθύς (G2117) and δρόμος (G1408); to lay a straight course, i.e. sail direct. KJV: (come) with a straight course.

ευθυμεω.def: from εὔθυμος (G2115); to cheer up, i.e. (intransitively) be cheerful; neuter comparative (adverbially) more cheerfully. KJV: be of good cheer (merry).

ευθυμοσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and θυμός (G2372); in fine spirits, i.e. cheerful. KJV: of good cheer, the more cheerfully.

ευθυνω.def: from εὐθύς (G2117); to straighten (level); technically, to steer. KJV: governor, make straight.

ευθυσ.def: perhaps from εὖ (G2095) and τίθημι (G5087); straight, i.e. (literally) level, or (figuratively) true; adverbially (of time) at once. KJV: anon, by and by, forthwith, immediately, straightway.

ευκαιρεω.def: from εὔκαιρος (G2121); to have good time, i.e. opportunity or leisure. KJV: have leisure (convenient time), spend time.

ευκαιρια.def: from εὔκαιρος (G2121); a favorable occasion. KJV: opportunity.

ευκαιροσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and καιρός (G2540); well-timed, i.e. opportune. KJV: convenient, in time of need.

ευκαιρωσ.def: adverb from εὔκαιρος (G2121); opportunely. KJV: conveniently, in season.

ευκοπωτεροσ.def: comparative of a compound of εὖ (G2095) and κόπος (G2873); better for toil, i.e. more facile. KJV: easier.

ευλαβεια.def: from εὐλαβής (G2126); properly, caution, i.e. (religiously) reverence (piety); by implication, dread (concretely). KJV: fear(-ed).

ευλαβεομαι.def: middle voice from εὐλαβής (G2126); to be circumspect, i.e. (by implication) to be apprehensive; religiously, to reverence. KJV: (moved with) fear.

ευλαβησ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and λαμβάνω (G2983); taking well (carefully), i.e. circumspect (religiously, pious). KJV: devout.

ευλογεω.def: from a compound of εὖ (G2095) and λόγος (G3056); to speak well of, i.e. (religiously) to bless (thank or invoke a benediction upon, prosper). KJV: bless, praise.

ευλογια.def: from the same as εὐλογέω (G2127); fine speaking, i.e. elegance of language; commendation ("eulogy"), i.e. (reverentially) adoration; religiously, benediction; by implication, consecration; by extension, benefit or largess. KJV: blessing (a matter of) bounty (X -tifully), fair speech.

ευμεταδοτοσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and a presumed derivative of μεταδίδωμι (G3330); good at imparting, i.e. liberal. KJV: ready to distribute.

ευνικη.def: from εὖ (G2095) and νίκη (G3529); victorious; Eunice, a Jewess. KJV: Eunice.

ευνοεω.def: from a compound of εὖ (G2095) and νοῦς (G3563); to be well- minded, i.e. reconcile. KJV: agree.

ευνοια.def: from the same as εὐνοέω (G2132); kindness; euphemistically, conjugal duty. KJV: benevolence, good will.

ευνουχιζω.def: from εὐνοῦχος (G2135); to castrate (figuratively, live unmarried). KJV: make…eunuch.

ευνουχοσ.def: from εὐνή (a bed) and ἔχω (G2192); a castrated person (such being employed in Oriental bed-chambers); by extension an impotent or unmarried man; by implication, a chamberlain (state-officer). KJV: eunuch.

ευοδια.def: from the same as εὐοδόω (G2137); fine travelling; Euodia, a Christian woman. KJV: Euodias.

ευοδοω.def: from a compound of εὖ (G2095) and ὁδός (G3598); to help on the road, i.e. (passively) succeed in reaching; figuratively, to succeed in business affairs. KJV: (have a) prosper(-ous journey).

ευπειθησ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and πείθω (G3982); good for persuasion, i.e. (intransitively) complaint. KJV: easy to be intreated.

ευπεριστατοσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and a derivative of a presumed compound of περί (G4012) and ἵστημι (G2476); well standing around, i.e. (a competitor) thwarting (a racer) in every direction (figuratively, of sin in genitive case). KJV: which doth so easily beset.

ευποιια.def: from a compound of εὖ (G2095) and ποιέω (G4160); well-doing, i.e. beneficence. KJV: to do good.

ευπορεω.def: from a compound of ἑτοιμάζω (G2090) and the base of πορεία (G4197); (intransitively) to be good for passing through, i.e. (figuratively) have pecuniary means. KJV: ability.

ευπορια.def: from the same as εὐπορέω (G2141); pecuniary resources. KJV: wealth.

ευπρεπεια.def: from a compound of εὖ (G2095) and πρέπω (G4241); good suitableness, i.e. gracefulness. KJV: grace.

ευπροσδεκτοσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and a derivative of προσδέχομαι (G4327); well-received, i.e. approved, favorable. KJV: acceptable(-ted).

ευπροσεδροσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and the same as προσεδρεύω (G4332); sitting well towards, i.e. (figuratively) assiduous (neuter, diligent service). KJV: X attend upon.

ευπροσωπεω.def: from a compound of εὖ (G2095) and πρόσωπον (G4383); to be of good countenance, i.e. (figuratively) to make a display. KJV: make a fair show.

ευρισκω.def: a prolonged form of a primary εὕρω, which (together with another cognate form) εὑρέω is used for it in all the tenses except the present and imperfect; to find (literally or figuratively). KJV: find, get, obtain, perceive, see.

ευροκλυδων.def: from Εὖρος (the east wind) and κλύδων (G2830); a storm from the East (or southeast), i.e. (in modern phrase) a Levanter. KJV: Euroklydon.

ευρυχωροσ.def: from εὐρύς (wide) and χώρα (G5561); spacious. KJV: broad.

ευσεβεια.def: from εὐσεβής (G2152); piety; specially, the gospel scheme. KJV: godliness, holiness.

ευσεβεω.def: from εὐσεβής (G2152); to be pious, i.e. (towards God) to worship, or (towards parents) to respect (support). KJV: show piety, worship.

ευσεβησ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and σέβομαι (G4576); well-reverent, i.e. pious. KJV: devout, godly.

ευσεβωσ.def: adverb from εὐσεβής (G2152); piously. KJV: godly.

ευσημοσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and the base of σημαίνω (G4591); well indicated, i.e. (figuratively) significant. KJV: easy to be understood.

ευσπλαγχνοσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and σπλάγχνον (G4698); well compassioned, i.e. sympathetic. KJV: pitiful, tender-hearted.

ευσχημονωσ.def: adverb from εὐσχήμων (G2158); decorously. KJV: decently, honestly.

ευσχημων.def: from εὖ (G2095) and σχῆμα (G4976); well-formed, i.e. (figuratively) decorous, noble (in rank). KJV: comely, honourable.

ευτονωσ.def: adverb from a compound of εὖ (G2095) and a derivative of τείνω (to stretch); in a well-strung manner, i.e. (figuratively) intensely (in a good sense, cogently; in a bad one, fiercely). KJV: mightily, vehemently.

ευτραπελια.def: from a compound of εὖ (G2095) and a derivative of the base of τροπή (G5157) (meaning well-turned, i.e. ready at repartee, jocose); witticism, i.e. (in a vulgar sense) ribaldry. KJV: jesting.

ευτυχοσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and a derivative of τυγχάνω (G5177); well- fated, i.e. fortunate; Eutychus, a young man. KJV: Eutychus.

ευφημια.def: from εὔφημος (G2163); good language ("euphemy"), i.e. praise (repute). KJV: good report.

ευφημοσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and φήμη (G5345); well spoken of, i.e. reputable. KJV: of good report.

ευφορεω.def: from εὖ (G2095) and φορέω (G5409); to bear well, i.e. be fertile. KJV: bring forth abundantly.

ευφραινω.def: from εὖ (G2095) and φρήν (G5424); to put (middle voice or passively, be) in a good frame of mind, i.e. rejoice. KJV: fare, make glad, be (make) merry, rejoice.

ευφρατησ.def: of foreign origin (compare H6578); Euphrates, a river of Asia. KJV: Euphrates.

ευφροσυνη.def: from the same as εὐφραίνω (G2165); joyfulness. KJV: gladness, joy.

ευχαριστεω.def: from εὐχάριστος (G2170); to be grateful, i.e. (actively) to express gratitude (towards); specially, to say grace at a meal. KJV: (give) thank(-ful, -s).

ευχαριστια.def: from εὐχάριστος (G2170); gratitude; actively, grateful language (to God, as an act of worship). KJV: thankfulness, (giving of) thanks(-giving).

ευχαριστοσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and a derivative of χαρίζομαι (G5483); well favored, i.e. (by implication) grateful. KJV: thankful.

ευχη.def: from εὔχομαι (G2172); properly, a wish, expressed as a petition to God, or in votive obligation. KJV: prayer, vow.

ευχομαι.def: middle voice of a primary verb; to wish; by implication, to pray to God. KJV: pray, will, wish.

ευχρηστοσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and χρηστός (G5543); easily used, i.e. useful. KJV: profitable, meet for use.

ευψυχεω.def: from a compound of εὖ (G2095) and ψυχή (G5590); to be in good spirits, i.e. feel encouraged. KJV: be of good comfort.

ευωδια.def: from a compound of εὖ (G2095) and a derivative of ὄζω (G3605); good-scentedness, i.e. fragrance. KJV: sweet savour (smell, -smelling).

ευωνυμοσ.def: from εὖ (G2095) and ὄνομα (G3686); properly, well-named (good-omened), i.e. the left (which was the lucky side among the pagan Greeks); neuter as adverbial, at the left hand. KJV: (on the) left.

εφαλλομαι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἅλλομαι (G242); to spring upon. KJV: leap on.

εφαπαξ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἅπαξ (G530); upon one occasion (only). KJV: (at) once (for all).

εφεσινοσ.def: from Ἔφεσος (G2181); Ephesine, or situated at Ephesus. KJV: of Ephesus.

εφεσιοσ.def: from Ἔφεσος (G2181); an Ephesian or inhabitant of Ephesus. KJV: Ephesian, of Ephesus.

εφεσοσ.def: probably of foreign origin; Ephesus, a city of Asia Minor. KJV: Ephesus.

εφευρετησ.def: from a compound of ἐπί (G1909) and εὑρίσκω (G2147); a discoverer, i.e. contriver. KJV: inventor.

εφημερια.def: from ἐφήμερος (G2184); diurnality, i.e. (specially) the quotidian rotation or class of the Jewish priests' service at the Temple, as distributed by families. KJV: course.

εφημεροσ.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἡμέρα (G2250); for a day ("ephemeral"), i.e. diurnal. KJV: daily.

εφικνεομαι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and a cognate of ἥκω (G2240); to arrive upon, i.e. extend to. KJV: reach.

εφιστημι.def: from ἐπί (G1909) and ἵστημι (G2476); to stand upon, i.e. be present (in various applications, friendly or otherwise, usually literal);. KJV: assault, come (in, to, unto, upon), be at hand (instant), present, stand (before, by, over).

εφραιμ.def: of Hebrew origin (H669 or better H6085); Ephraim, a place in Palestine. KJV: Ephraim.

εφφαθα.def: of Chaldee origin (H6606); be opened!. KJV: Ephphatha.

εχθρα.def: feminine of ἐχθρός (G2190); hostility; by implication, a reason for opposition. KJV: enmity, hatred.

εχθροσ.def: from a primary ἔχθω (to hate); hateful (passively, odious, or actively, hostile); usually as a noun, an adversary (especially Satan). KJV: enemy, foe.

εχιδνα.def: of uncertain origin; an adder or other poisonous snake (literally or figuratively). KJV: viper.

εχω.def: a primary verb; to hold (used in very various applications, literally or figuratively, direct or remote; such as possession; ability, contiuity, relation, or condition). KJV: be (able, X hold, possessed with), accompany, + begin to amend, can(+ -not), X conceive, count, diseased, do + eat, + enjoy, + fear, following, have, hold, keep, + lack, + go to law, lie, + must needs, + of necessity, + need, next, + recover, + reign, + rest, + return, X sick, take for, + tremble, + uncircumcised, use.

εωσ.def: of uncertain affinity; a conjunction, preposition and adverb of continuance, until (of time and place). KJV: even (until, unto), (as) far (as), how long, (un-)til(-l), (hither-, un-, up) to, while(-s).
